degrees.full: Bachelor of Technology / Bachelor of Engineering (Computer Science, Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, ECE)
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, BITSAT, VITEEE, MHT-CET, KCET, WBJEE, CUET-UG
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM); AICTE also permits select bridge subjects in specific branches.
degrees.desc: Design, build and improve software, hardware, machines, civil infrastructure or electrical systems.
degrees.path: Software engineer, core mechanical/civil/electrical engineer, embedded systems engineer, PSU technical officer (via GATE).
degrees.pay: ₹3.5–10 LPA (entry-level median across tiers); ₹12–30+ LPA at premier IITs/NITs/IIITs/BITS.
degrees.why: Choose it if you enjoy solving technical problems, building systems and learning continuously. Pick a branch for its actual subjects—not only placement headlines.
degrees.demand: Strong across software, semiconductor/VLSI, power, EVs and infrastructure; outcomes depend on skills and college tier.
degrees.institutes: IITs (Kharagpur, Bombay, Madras, Kanpur, Delhi, Roorkee), NITs, IIITs, BITS Pilani, DTU, Anna University, Jadavpur University

degrees.full: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning & Data Engineering
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, BITSAT, IIIT-H UGEE, state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) with strong foundation in calculus, linear algebra and probability.
degrees.desc: Build intelligent algorithms, machine learning models, computer vision, NLP and automated decision systems.
degrees.path: ML engineer, AI application developer, data engineer, computer vision / NLP specialist, applied AI researcher.
degrees.pay: ₹5–14 LPA (entry roles); higher at top research institutes and product companies.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you love linear algebra, probability, algorithms and coding—not just the buzzword around AI.
degrees.demand: High demand for engineers who can deploy reliable ML systems, though research roles often favour M.Tech/MS/PhD.
degrees.institutes: IIT Hyderabad, IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Kharagpur, IIIT Hyderabad, IIIT Allahabad, IISc Bengaluru

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Aeronautical or Aerospace Engineering (plus Avionics)
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, State CETs, AMAeSI (AeSI) route
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Design, test and maintain aircraft (aeronautical) and spacecraft/launch vehicles (astronautical/aerospace).
degrees.path: Aerodynamicist, propulsion engineer, avionics engineer, aircraft maintenance/design at ISRO, DRDO, HAL, Airbus, Boeing or private space startups.
degrees.why: Ideal if you are fascinated by flight mechanics, propulsion, orbital mechanics and advanced physics.
degrees.demand: Growing with India’s private space-tech ecosystem, defence indigenisation and commercial aviation expansion.
degrees.institutes: IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Kanpur, IIST Thiruvananthapuram, PEC Chandigarh, MIT Anna University, IIEST Shibpur

degrees.full: B.Tech CSE (Cyber Security, Information Security & Blockchain Technology)
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, CUET-UG, state CETs, university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Protect networks, cloud systems and financial ledgers against cyber threats, cryptography attacks and data breaches.
degrees.path: Security analyst (SOC), penetration tester, cloud security engineer, cryptography / distributed ledger developer.
degrees.why: Choose it if you enjoy networking internals, operating systems, cryptography and ethical security auditing.
degrees.demand: High enterprise and banking demand due to strict data-protection compliance (DPDP Act, CERT-In norms).
degrees.institutes: IIIT Hyderabad, IIIT Allahabad, IIT Delhi, IIT Hyderabad, IIIT Guwahati, NSUT, NIT Surathkal

degrees.full: B.Tech in Robotics, Mechatronics & Industrial Automation
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, BITSAT, state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Combine mechanical design, electronics, sensors and control software to build robots and automated factories. Instrumentation has its own card.
degrees.path: Robotics engineer, industrial automation specialist, EV and autonomous-systems engineer.
degrees.why: Great for students who want to work at the intersection of hardware, sensors, microcontrollers and code.
degrees.demand: Increasing adoption in automotive manufacturing, warehouse automation, defence and medical robotics.
degrees.institutes: IIT Kanpur, IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IISc, BITS Pilani/Mesra, NIT Silchar, BMSCE, MSRIT Bengaluru

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Biomedical Engineering or Medical Electronics Engineering
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, state CETs, CUET-UG (PCMB or PCM)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with PCM (or PCMB); select universities accept PCB with bridge maths.
degrees.desc: Apply engineering principles to design MRI/CT scanners, prostheses, artificial organs and clinical diagnostic devices.
degrees.path: Biomedical device R&D engineer, clinical engineer in hospital chains, medical imaging hardware specialist, biomechanics researcher.
degrees.why: Choose it if you want to build healthcare technology, diagnostic machines and rehabilitative devices.
degrees.demand: Growing domestic MedTech manufacturing and hospital infrastructure across India.
degrees.institutes: IIT BHU Varanasi, IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, Osmania University Hyderabad, BMSCE Bengaluru, Govt. Model Engg College Kochi

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Biotechnology, Bioprocess & Biochemical Engineering
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, state CETs, CUET-UG
degrees.elig: 10+2 with PCM or PCMB (some private/state universities also admit PCB students).
degrees.desc: Combine chemical/bioprocess engineering with genetics and molecular biology to scale vaccines, biologics and biofuels.
degrees.path: Bioprocess engineer, vaccine/biologics manufacturing specialist, bioinformatics analyst, pharma R&D engineer.
degrees.why: Ideal if you want engineering-scale applications of gene therapy, fermentation, drug design and biomanufacturing.
degrees.demand: Strong in biopharma hubs (Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Ahmedabad); higher study expands R&D leadership.
degrees.institutes: IIT Kharagpur, IIT Roorkee, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, ICT Mumbai, NIT Warangal, Anna University

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Chemical Engineering
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, MHT-CET, WBJEE, state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Design chemical plants, batteries, petrochemicals and green-hydrogen processes. Polymer and ceramic engineering have their own cards.
degrees.path: Process engineer, petrochemical / refinery engineer (ONGC, IOCL), battery and green-energy engineer, pharma process roles.
degrees.pay: ₹4–9 LPA (higher in PSU refineries and specialty chemical multinationals).
degrees.why: Choose it if you like industrial chemistry, thermodynamics, materials science and large-scale process design.
degrees.demand: Steady core demand across specialty chemicals, pharma, green energy and refining.
degrees.institutes: ICT Mumbai, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Kanpur, IIT Madras, IIT BHU, NIT Rourkela, BIT Mesra, Anna University

degrees.full: B.Tech in Metallurgical & Materials Engineering
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, WBJEE, state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Study alloys, steel, semiconductor and aerospace materials, extraction and heat treatment. Mining has its own card.
degrees.path: Metallurgist or materials engineer at Tata Steel, JSW, SAIL, Vedanta, DRDO and auto or aerospace suppliers.
degrees.pay: ₹4.5–10 LPA (strong PSU and core metal/mining placements from premier institutes).
degrees.why: A great fit if you want core industrial engineering roles in materials, alloys, EV minerals and resource extraction.
degrees.demand: Steady core industry demand from steel, EV batteries, aerospace and manufacturing; limited seats at top institutes help placement.
degrees.institutes: IIT (BHU) Varanasi, IIT Roorkee, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Bombay, NIT Trichy, NIT Surathkal, IIEST Shibpur, COEP Pune

degrees.full: B.Tech in Automobile Engineering, Industrial Engineering or Manufacturing Science
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Design vehicles, EV powertrains, factory production systems, supply-chain operations and quality engineering.
degrees.path: Automotive design/testing engineer, EV powertrain engineer, industrial/operations engineer, supply-chain & production manager.
degrees.why: Choose it if you are passionate about vehicles, EVs, manufacturing plants and optimising complex production systems.
degrees.demand: Strong transformation with Electric Vehicles (EVs), smart factories and operations consulting.
degrees.institutes: IIT Kharagpur, IIT Kanpur, MIT Anna University, PSG Tech Coimbatore, COEP Pune, DTU Delhi

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Textile Engineering, Textile Chemistry or Fibre Science
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Engineer technical textiles, composite fibres, medical/aerospace fabrics, dyeing chemistry and apparel machinery.
degrees.path: Technical textile engineer, fibre R&D specialist, textile plant manager, apparel merchandising & quality head.
degrees.why: Consider it for technical textiles (kevlar, carbon fibre, medical textiles) as well as large-scale apparel manufacturing.
degrees.demand: Specialised demand in technical textiles, export houses and polymer/fibre industries.
degrees.institutes: IIT Delhi, ICT Mumbai, UPTTI Kanpur, Govt SKSJTI Bengaluru, GCETTB Berhampore

degrees.full: Bachelor of Architecture
degrees.exam: NATA (Council of Architecture), JEE Main Paper 2A
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) or 10+3 Diploma with Mathematics as per Council of Architecture (CoA) norms.
degrees.desc: Plan buildings, urban spaces and sustainable built environments governed under the Architects Act, 1972.
degrees.path: Licensed Architect (registered with Council of Architecture), urban designer, BIM specialist, sustainable design consultant.
degrees.pay: ₹3–6 LPA (entry studio roles); grows with CoA practice, BIM expertise and project portfolio.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you enjoy design, buildings, spatial thinking and detailed project work—and are ready for a demanding 5-year studio workload.
degrees.demand: Construction, urban transit and green-building cycles drive hiring; portfolio and BIM skills are vital.
degrees.institutes: SPA Delhi/Bhopal/Vijayawada, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Roorkee, CEPT Ahmedabad, NIT Trichy, Sir JJ College of Architecture, Jamia Millia Islamia

degrees.full: Bachelor of Planning
degrees.exam: JEE Main Paper 2B (B.Plan), CUET-UG, state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Mathematics.
degrees.desc: Study cities, urban infrastructure, land use, transport networks, housing policy and GIS regional development.
degrees.path: Urban and regional planner, transport planner, GIS specialist, smart-city consultant, development authority officer.
degrees.why: Good for students curious about how cities work and who want to combine data, policy, maps and public impact.
degrees.demand: Opportunities in urban local bodies, infrastructure consulting firms (AECOM, WSP, Big 4) and housing authorities.
degrees.institutes: SPA Delhi, SPA Bhopal, SPA Vijayawada, CEPT Ahmedabad, MANIT Bhopal, NIT Calicut, Guru Nanak Dev University

degrees.full: Bachelor of Computer Applications
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, IPU CET, SET, Christ/Symbiosis/university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (some universities require Mathematics/Computer Science/Informatics Practices at 10+2).
degrees.desc: A computing-focused route into software development, web/mobile applications, databases and IT careers.
degrees.path: Software developer, full-stack web developer, QA engineer, cloud/IT support; pairing with MCA or strong projects unlocks top product roles.
degrees.why: Choose it if you genuinely like coding and building digital solutions. Projects and practical ability matter as much as the degree title.
degrees.demand: IT remains a large field, but entry-level competition is high; build a strong GitHub portfolio and fundamentals.
degrees.institutes: Christ University, Symbiosis (SICSR), GGSIPU Delhi, Loyola College, University of Madras, Presidency College, NIELIT

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Computer Science / Information Technology
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Mathematics (required by DU and most central universities for B.Sc Hons CS).
degrees.desc: Study algorithms, theory of computation, computer systems, networks and software engineering.
degrees.path: Software developer, systems analyst, networking specialist, QA engineer, or M.Sc/MCA/research pathway.
degrees.why: A strong fit if you want a rigorous computer-science foundation at a university and practise programming outside class.
degrees.demand: Demand depends on coding depth, internships and algorithmic problem-solving.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi (Hansraj, SSCBS, St. Stephen’s), Banaras Hindu University, Mumbai University, Loyola College Chennai

degrees.full: B.Sc / BS in Data Science, Programming, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, IIT Madras BS Qualifier, university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Mathematics / Statistics for most programmes; some programmes (such as the IIT Madras online BS) admit any stream through a qualifier.
degrees.desc: Use Python/R, statistical inference and machine learning to interpret complex datasets.
degrees.path: Data analyst, business intelligence (BI) engineer, junior data scientist, quantitative analyst.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you like statistics, coding and finding patterns in messy information—not just the popularity of AI.
degrees.demand: Data and AI skills are sought after, though advanced data-science roles are competitive and expect real projects.
degrees.institutes: IIT Madras (BS Data Science), IIT Guwahati, Delhi University, NMIMS, Christ University, Symbiosis

degrees.full: B.Sc Physical Sciences / B.Tech Physical Sciences (Space & Astronomy)
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, JEE Advanced (for IIST Thiruvananthapuram), IISER IAT
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Interdisciplinary study of physics, chemistry, mathematics, optics, space science and astronomy.
degrees.path: Space research (ISRO/IIST), scientific instrumentation, defence labs, analytics, teaching or M.Sc/PhD in Astrophysics.
degrees.pay: ₹3–7 LPA (higher for IIST/ISRO scientist absorption subject to performance rules).
degrees.why: Choose it if you want a broad foundation across physics, chemistry and maths or aspire to space/astronomy research.
degrees.demand: Strong foundation for interdisciplinary research, space science, teaching and quantitative analytics.
degrees.institutes: IIST Thiruvananthapuram, IIT Delhi/Bombay/Madras, University of Delhi, IISc, Osmania University

degrees.full: BS-MS Dual Degree / 4-Year BS Research in Basic Sciences
degrees.exam: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT); some IISER seats also via JEE Advanced; NEST for NISER and UM-DAE CEBS. Verify the current admission channels.
degrees.elig: 10+2 in Science stream (PCM or PCB/PCMB).
degrees.desc: Premier research-oriented undergraduate education in Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology and Earth Sciences.
degrees.path: Funded PhD in India/abroad, R&D scientist, quantitative researcher, biotech/chemical/data science specialist.
degrees.pay: ₹4–9 LPA in industry R&D/analytics; many graduates pursue funded fellowships/PhDs globally.
degrees.why: Best for students who love science itself, enjoy asking fundamental questions and want world-class laboratory exposure.
degrees.demand: High global recognition for doctoral admissions and deep-tech R&D roles.
degrees.institutes: IISc Bengaluru, IISERs (Pune, Kolkata, Mohali, Bhopal, Thiruvananthapuram, Tirupati, Berhampur), NISER Bhubaneswar, CEBS Mumbai

degrees.full: Bachelor of Statistics (Hons) / Bachelor of Mathematics (Hons)
degrees.exam: ISI Admission Test, CMI Entrance Exam, CUET-UG (for B.Sc Hons Stat)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Mathematics and English.
degrees.desc: Elite training in probability, mathematical statistics, real analysis, stochastic processes and computing.
degrees.path: Quantitative researcher, statistician, risk modeller, data scientist, Indian Statistical Service (ISS) after PG, academic research.
degrees.why: A top fit if you enjoy rigorous proofs, probability and abstract mathematical problem-solving.
degrees.demand: Exceptional demand in quantitative finance, biostatistics, AI research and analytics.
degrees.institutes: Indian Statistical Institute (ISI Kolkata & Bengaluru), Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI), IIT Kharagpur, DU (Hindu, LSR, Ramjas), BHU

degrees.full: Bachelor of Pharmacy (4 yrs) / Doctor of Pharmacy Integrated (6 yrs)
degrees.exam: State CETs (MHT-CET, KCET, WBJEE, GUJCET), CUET-UG, BITSAT, GPAT (for PG)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics OR Biology (PCM or PCB).
degrees.desc: Study drug discovery, pharmacology, pharmaceutics, medicinal chemistry, clinical pharmacy and drug regulation.
degrees.path: Pharmaceutical R&D, quality assurance (QA/QC), regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, clinical research, licensed pharmacist, drug inspector.
degrees.why: Choose it if you are interested in how medicines work, chemical formulation, patient safety and India’s global pharma sector.
degrees.demand: India is a major global vaccine and generic drug producer; PCI-approved college and PG specialisation boost career growth.
degrees.institutes: ICT Mumbai, Jamia Hamdard New Delhi, BITS Pilani, DPSRU New Delhi, IIT BHU, Manipal (MCOPS), Panjab University, NIPERs (for PG)

degrees.full: B.A. / B.Sc (Hons) Economics
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, GIPE/Symbiosis/St. Xavier’s/Ashoka/Christ entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream; Mathematics at 10+2 is mandatory for B.A. (Hons) Economics at DU and top quantitative programmes.
degrees.desc: Analyse micro/macroeconomics, econometrics, game theory, public policy, trade and financial markets.
degrees.path: Economic analyst, management consulting, banking & finance, public policy research, Indian Economic Service (IES) after PG.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you enjoy understanding incentives, markets and public policy and are willing to master statistics and econometrics.
degrees.demand: Highly versatile across corporate strategy, finance, analytics and policy think-tanks.
degrees.institutes: SRCC, St. Stephen’s, LSR, Hindu College (DU), Presidency University Kolkata, St. Xavier’s Mumbai/Kolkata, IGIDR/DSE/ISI (for PG)

degrees.full: B.Sc Aviation / Commercial Pilot Licence (DGCA CPL) & Aircraft Maintenance (AME)
degrees.exam: IGRUA entrance, DGCA CPL exams, NFTI/university tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (mandatory for DGCA CPL; non-PCM students can clear Physics/Maths via NIOS).
degrees.desc: Study meteorology, air navigation, aircraft regulations and aviation operations; pilot licensing requires separate DGCA flight hours.
degrees.path: Commercial Pilot (via 200 hrs DGCA CPL + Type Rating), Airline Operations, Air Traffic Control (AAI exam), Flight Dispatcher.
degrees.pay: Ground/ops entry: ₹3–6 LPA; Airline Junior First Officer pay is higher but requires ₹35–60+ Lakh self-funded flight training.
degrees.why: Choose it only after researching DGCA Class 1 Medical fitness, total flight-training cost and realistic airline hiring cycles.
degrees.demand: Indian airlines have large aircraft orders, but CPL training is capital-intensive and hiring happens in batches.
degrees.institutes: IGRUA Amethi, NFTI Gondia, Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU), Mumbai University

degrees.full: B.Sc Nautical Science / Deck Cadet pathway (DG Shipping approved)
degrees.exam: IMU-CET (Indian Maritime University) or institute tests, plus company sponsorship; DG Shipping medical.
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (usually at least 60% PCM) and English (usually at least 50%), plus DG Shipping medical and vision standards.
degrees.desc: Train for ship navigation, cargo handling and bridge watch-keeping as a deck officer. Marine engineering and naval architecture have their own cards.
degrees.path: Deck Cadet, Third Officer, Second Officer, Chief Officer, Captain; shipping-company and port roles.
degrees.pay: ₹4–12+ LPA (tax-exempt NRI status when sailing ≥182 days outside India; varies by vessel type and shipping company).
degrees.why: A fit if you want a global maritime career, can handle months at sea and meet strict eyesight/medical standards.
degrees.demand: Global shipping relies on trained officers; always secure company sponsorship before joining a pre-sea course.
degrees.institutes: IMU campuses (Kolkata, Navi Mumbai, Chennai, Kochi), Tolani Maritime Institute, other DG Shipping-approved institutes

degrees.full: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery
degrees.exam: NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English (minimum 50% PCB for General, 40% for reserved categories).
degrees.desc: Train in modern science-supported clinical medicine, diagnostics, pharmacology, surgery and patient care (4.5 yrs + 1 yr internship).
degrees.path: Medical Officer, hospital resident, general practitioner, or specialist/super-specialist via NEET-PG / INI-CET (MD/MS/DNB).
degrees.pay: Indicatively ₹6–12 LPA for junior resident / medical officer roles; varies by state and hospital.
degrees.why: Pursue it for sustained commitment to patient care, clinical science and responsibility. Training is long, rigorous and usually continues into PG.
degrees.demand: Strong nationwide healthcare need; government medical seats are highly competitive while private colleges have high tuition fees.
degrees.institutes: AIIMS (New Delhi & all AIIMS), JIPMER Puducherry, CMC Vellore, AFMC Pune, MAMC New Delhi, IMS-BHU, KGMU Lucknow, Kempegowda/MMC

degrees.full: Bachelor of Dental Surgery
degrees.exam: NEET-UG
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English (NEET-UG qualified).
degrees.desc: Clinical training in oral diagnosis, dental surgery, orthodontics, prosthodontics, periodontics and cosmetic dentistry (4 yrs + 1 yr internship).
degrees.path: Dental surgeon in hospitals/corporate chains, private dental clinic owner, Armed Forces Dental Corps, MDS specialisation or MPH.
degrees.pay: ₹2.5–6 LPA (early salaried associate roles); established clinical practice or MDS increases earnings.
degrees.why: A fit if you enjoy fine manual dexterity, clinical procedures and patient interaction, and understand that building a private practice takes time.
degrees.demand: High competition in metro cities; MDS specialisation (Orthodontics, Endodontics, Oral Surgery) and tier-2/3 clinical setups help.
degrees.institutes: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences (MAIDS) Delhi, Faculty of Dentistry Jamia Millia Islamia, Manipal (MCODS), Nair Hospital Dental Mumbai, GDC Rohtak/Hyderabad

degrees.full: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine & Surgery (BAMS) / Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine & Surgery (BHMS)
degrees.exam: NEET-UG (with AACCC All-India & State AYUSH Counselling)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) + NEET-UG qualification.
degrees.desc: Regulated 5.5-year degree (4.5 yrs study + 1 yr internship) in Ayurveda or Homeopathy under NCISM / NCH.
degrees.path: AYUSH Medical Officer (central/state dispensaries), clinical practice, Ayurvedic/wellness hospitals, clinical research, MD/MS (via AIAPGET).
degrees.pay: ₹3–6.5 LPA (salaried hospital/government entry roles vary by state).
degrees.why: Choose after understanding the curriculum, clinical scope and registration rules under NCISM/NCH.
degrees.demand: Opportunities in government AYUSH missions, wellness hospitals and private practice.
degrees.institutes: All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA) New Delhi, IMS-BHU Varanasi, National Institute of Ayurveda (NIA) Jaipur, NIH Kolkata, NHMC Delhi

degrees.full: Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry
degrees.exam: NEET-UG (15% VCI All-India Quota & most states), State Veterinary CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English.
degrees.desc: Study animal medicine, surgery, livestock production, zoonotic disease control and companion-animal clinical care (4.5 yrs + 1 yr internship).
degrees.path: Government Veterinary Officer, small-animal pet clinic veterinarian, dairy/poultry/pharma sector veterinarian, wildlife vet, M.V.Sc.
degrees.pay: ₹4–7.5 LPA (strong demand in state animal husbandry departments and urban pet healthcare).
degrees.why: Good for students committed to animal health, practical clinical surgery and working with both pet owners and livestock farmers.
degrees.demand: High absorption in state government veterinary services, dairy cooperatives (Amul/NDDB) and urban companion-animal clinics.
degrees.institutes: IVRI Izatnagar (Bareilly), TANUVAS Chennai, GADVASU Ludhiana, LUVAS Hisar, Mumbai Veterinary College (MAFSU), GBPUAT Pantnagar

degrees.full: Bachelor of Science in Nursing
degrees.exam: AIIMS B.Sc Nursing entrance, NEET-UG or state / university nursing entrance (varies by state and institute).
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English (minimum 45% in PCBE as per Indian Nursing Council).
degrees.desc: Clinical and critical-care nursing education regulated by the Indian Nursing Council (INC).
degrees.path: Nursing Officer (AIIMS NORCET / Central & State Hospitals), Military Nursing Service (MNS), ICU/OT nurse, international nursing (NCLEX/OET), M.Sc Nursing.
degrees.pay: ₹3–8 LPA in India (AIIMS NORCET central government nursing officers start around ₹7–8.5 LPA); higher abroad.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you value clinical care, teamwork and practical medical responsibility with clear domestic and global mobility.
degrees.demand: Consistently high domestic (AIIMS/corporate hospitals) and international healthcare demand.
degrees.institutes: AIIMS (New Delhi & regional AIIMS), CMC Vellore, JIPMER Puducherry, AFMC Pune, PGIMER Chandigarh, RAK College of Nursing Delhi, Manipal

degrees.full: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) / Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (BOT)
degrees.exam: State CETs (MHT-CET, IPU CET, BCECE), CUET-UG, SVNIRTAR NILD CET, NEET-UG (in select states)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB).
degrees.desc: Clinical rehabilitation for movement, orthopaedics, neurology, sports injuries and functional independence (4 yrs + 6-month internship).
degrees.path: Hospital physiotherapist/occupational therapist, sports team physio, neuro/paediatric rehab specialist, independent clinic, MPT/MOT.
degrees.why: A fit if you like anatomy, biomechanics and helping patients recover mobility and daily independence after injury or illness.
degrees.demand: Growing rapidly with ageing demographics, orthopaedic surgeries, sports medicine and paediatric occupational therapy.
degrees.institutes: Pt. Deendayal Upadhyaya National Institute (PDUNIPPD) Delhi, SVNIRTAR Cuttack, NILD Kolkata, KEM/Seth GS Mumbai, CMC Vellore, Manipal, NIMS Hyderabad

degrees.full: Bachelor in Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology
degrees.exam: AIISH Mysuru Entrance, AIIMS / PGIMER Entrance, AYJNISHD Entrance, university tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics (PCB or PCM).
degrees.desc: RCI-regulated clinical degree diagnosing and treating hearing disorders, cochlear implants, speech, language and swallowing conditions (3 yrs + 1 yr internship).
degrees.path: Clinical Audiologist, Speech-Language Pathologist in hospitals/cochlear-implant companies, special schools, private clinic, MASLP.
degrees.why: An underrated, high-impact clinical profession combining medical acoustics, neurology and patient rehabilitation.
degrees.demand: High shortage of RCI-registered audiologists and speech therapists across hospitals, hearing-aid MNCs and child development centres.
degrees.institutes: All India Institute of Speech & Hearing (AIISH) Mysuru, AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, AYJNISHD Mumbai, Manipal (MCHP), MERF Chennai

degrees.full: B.Sc in Operation Theatre & Anaesthesia Tech, Cardiac Perfusion, Dialysis or Critical Care Technology
degrees.exam: AIIMS Paramedical Entrance, JIPMER, state paramedical CETs, Manipal/CMC Vellore tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB).
degrees.desc: Specialised clinical technologists managing ICU life-support, heart-lung machines, anaesthesia delivery and surgical theatres.
degrees.path: OT & anaesthesia technologist, clinical perfusionist, dialysis technologist, emergency medical technologist in tertiary hospitals.
degrees.why: Choose a specific NCAHP-recognised specialisation at a teaching hospital with high surgical/ICU patient volume.
degrees.demand: High demand in multi-specialty hospital chains (Apollo, Fortis, Medanta, Max, AIIMS).
degrees.institutes: AIIMS New Delhi, CMC Vellore, PGIMER Chandigarh, JIPMER Puducherry, Manipal (MCHP), Sri Ramachandra Chennai

degrees.full: Bachelor of Optometry
degrees.exam: AIIMS Paramedical Entrance, CUET-UG, state CETs, university entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics (PCB or PCM).
degrees.desc: Clinical eye-care profession covering refraction, contact lenses, low-vision rehabilitation, binocular vision and ocular diagnostics (3 yrs + 1 yr internship).
degrees.path: Clinical Optometrist at eye hospitals (LVPEI, Sankara Nethralaya, AIIMS), optical retail chains (Titan, Lenskart), lens MNCs (Essilor, Zeiss), independent practice.
degrees.why: Good if you want a patient-facing healthcare profession with regular hours, combining optics, diagnostics and clinical care.
degrees.demand: Rising screen time and ageing populations drive steady demand across eye hospitals and retail chains.
degrees.institutes: AIIMS New Delhi, Elite School of Optometry (Sankara Nethralaya) Chennai, Manipal (MCHP), Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune, University of Hyderabad

degrees.full: Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology
degrees.exam: AIIMS/PGIMER Paramedical, CUET-UG, state paramedical CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB).
degrees.desc: Perform clinical pathology, biochemistry, microbiology, haematology and molecular diagnostics (PCR/ELISA) on patient samples.
degrees.path: Medical lab technologist, molecular diagnostics specialist, quality manager in diagnostic chains (Dr. Lal PathLabs, Metropolis, SRL) and hospital labs.
degrees.why: A fit if you are careful, systematic and interested in clinical diagnostics and laboratory instrumentation.
degrees.demand: Diagnostics is the backbone of modern medicine; hospital accreditation (NABL/NABH) requires qualified MLT graduates.
degrees.institutes: PGIMER Chandigarh, AIIMS, CMC Vellore, JIPMER Puducherry, Manipal, Jamia Hamdard

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Medical Technology in Radiography / Medical Imaging & Radiotherapy Technology
degrees.exam: AIIMS Paramedical, PGIMER, JIPMER, RGUHS/state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and/or Mathematics.
degrees.desc: Operate diagnostic X-Ray, CT, MRI, PET-CT, ultrasound support and oncology radiation therapy equipment with strict radiation safety.
degrees.path: Radiographer, CT/MRI technologist, radiotherapy technologist (AERB certified), application specialist at GE/Siemens/Philips Healthcare.
degrees.why: Choose it if you like high-tech medical imaging physics, precision and working in diagnostic or cancer-care teams.
degrees.demand: Strong demand in diagnostic imaging centres and oncology hospitals across tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
degrees.institutes: AIIMS New Delhi, Tata Memorial Hospital Mumbai, PGIMER Chandigarh, UCMS & GTB Hospital Delhi, JIPMER Puducherry, RGUHS Bengaluru

degrees.full: Bachelor of Hospital Administration / Hospital & Healthcare Management
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance tests (IIHMR, Manipal, Symbiosis, WBJEEB)
degrees.elig: 10+2 in Science (PCB) or any stream depending on university.
degrees.desc: Manage hospital operations, healthcare quality accreditation (NABH), patient services, medical insurance (TPA) and health-tech.
degrees.path: Hospital operations executive, quality & patient safety coordinator, health insurance/TPA analyst, progression to MHA/MPH.
degrees.why: Ideal if you want to work in the healthcare sector in management, operations and administration rather than clinical surgery.
degrees.demand: Expanding corporate hospital networks and health-insurance coverage create steady administrative openings.
degrees.institutes: TISS Mumbai, AIIMS (MHA), Kasturba Medical College Manipal, IIHMR, Symbiosis (SIHS) Pune, Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya Indore

degrees.full: Bachelor of Science in Public Health / Epidemiology & Community Health
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance or merit
degrees.elig: 10+2 in Science (PCB/PCM) or any stream depending on institution.
degrees.desc: Study epidemiology, disease prevention, health policy, biostatistics, maternal/child health and community programmes.
degrees.path: Public-health programme officer, epidemiologist assistant (after MPH), CSR health manager, WHO/UNICEF/NHM project coordinator.
degrees.why: A fit if you care about preventing disease at a population level and enjoy data, field surveys and health policy.
degrees.demand: Growing roles in National Health Mission (NHM), CSR foundations, public-health NGOs and clinical research.
degrees.institutes: JIPMER Puducherry, AIIMS Jodhpur, SRM, Manipal, Azim Premji University, IIPH (for MPH)

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Food Science, Nutrition and Dietetics
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, state & university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Home Science.
degrees.desc: Study human metabolism, clinical dietetics, food chemistry, therapeutic nutrition and public-health nutrition.
degrees.path: Clinical Dietitian (after M.Sc + Registered Dietitian internship), sports nutritionist, food-industry R&D/regulatory executive, wellness consultant.
degrees.why: Choose it if you enjoy biochemistry, food science and helping people manage health through evidence-based nutrition.
degrees.demand: Hospital clinical dietitian roles require recognised internships (IDA RD exam); sports and corporate wellness are also growing.
degrees.institutes: National Institute of Nutrition (NIN) Hyderabad, Lady Irwin College (DU), IHE (DU), SNDT Mumbai, CFTRI Mysuru (PG), Banasthali Vidyapith

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Home Science / Community Science (Resource Management, Human Development, Food & Textiles)
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, ICAR AIEEA-UG (for 4-yr B.Sc Hons Community Science)
degrees.elig: 10+2 in Science (PCB/PCM) or with Home Science/Agricultural Sciences.
degrees.desc: Interdisciplinary applied science covering Food & Nutrition, Human Development, Fabric & Apparel Science, and Resource Management.
degrees.path: Dietetics, early-childhood specialist, textile quality & merchandising, extension officer, CSR & community development, teaching.
degrees.why: Offers versatile specialisations ranging from clinical nutrition and child psychology to textile science and extension communication.
degrees.demand: Graduates specialise in nutrition, apparel design, early childhood education or rural extension services.
degrees.institutes: Lady Irwin College (DU), Institute of Home Economics (DU), Govt Home Science College Chandigarh, GBPUAT Pantnagar, SNDT Mumbai, PAU Ludhiana

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Biological Sciences, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry or Genetics
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, IISER IAT, university entrance or merit
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB/PCMB).
degrees.desc: Explore molecular biology, genetic engineering, immunology, plant tissue culture, microbes and cellular biochemistry.
degrees.path: Biotech/pharma QC & R&D lab analyst, clinical research coordinator, molecular diagnostics, or M.Sc/PhD via GAT-B / IIT JAM / CSIR-NET.
degrees.pay: ₹2.5–5 LPA (entry lab roles); higher after M.Sc/M.Tech/PhD.
degrees.why: Good for students who love laboratory experiments in genetics and microbiology and plan to build strong wet-lab or bioinformatics skills.
degrees.demand: Core R&D roles strongly favour postgraduate degrees (M.Sc via GAT-B/JAM); QC and clinical-trial roles hire graduates.
degrees.institutes: IISERs, Delhi University, St. Xavier’s Mumbai, Fergusson College Pune, BHU Varanasi, JNU (for PG via GAT-B/CUET-PG)

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Zoology, Botany or Life Sciences
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB).
degrees.desc: Study animal and plant physiology, taxonomy, evolutionary biology and ecology.
degrees.path: Lab and survey roles, environmental impact assessment support, botanical / zoological survey, teaching (after B.Ed / NET), M.Sc and research. (Wildlife biology has its own card.)
degrees.why: Pursue it if you are passionate about organisms, biodiversity and ecosystems, and are ready to pursue M.Sc/research or educator routes.
degrees.demand: Academic, environmental-consulting and teaching routes are primary.
degrees.institutes: BHU Varanasi, University of Delhi (Miranda House, Hansraj, Hindu), Presidency Kolkata, Madras Christian College

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Forensic Science (plus Cyber Forensics & Questioned Documents)
degrees.exam: NFAT (National Forensic Sciences University - NFSU), CUET-UG, state tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in Science stream (PCB or PCM).
degrees.desc: Apply DNA profiling, toxicology, ballistics, fingerprint analysis and digital forensics to criminal and civil investigations.
degrees.path: Forensic scientist/assistant in Central & State FSLs (via UPSC/SSC/State PSC), cyber forensics consultant in Big 4/banks, toxicology lab analyst.
degrees.why: Choose it for rigorous laboratory chemistry, biology and digital evidence procedures—prioritise government institutes like NFSU.
degrees.demand: New criminal laws (Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita - BNSS) mandate forensic evidence for serious offences, increasing FSL demand.
degrees.institutes: National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU Gandhinagar, Delhi, Goa, Tripura), Institute of Forensic Science Mumbai/Nagpur, Sagar University

degrees.full: B.A. / B.Sc (Hons) Psychology / Applied Psychology / Rehabilitation Psychology
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance or merit
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (Science, Commerce or Humanities).
degrees.desc: Study human cognition, developmental psychology, mental health, psychometrics, organisational behaviour and rehabilitation.
degrees.path: School/career counsellor (after PG Diploma), HR & organisational development, user research; RCI Clinical/Rehabilitation Psychologist requires M.Phil/M.Psy.
degrees.why: A fit if you are curious about human behaviour, research methods and empathy. Note that clinical practice requires RCI-recognised postgraduate training.
degrees.demand: Growing demand in schools, corporate wellbeing, UX research and hospitals.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi (LSR, Gargi, JMC, Zakir Husain), BHU Varanasi, TISS Mumbai, Christ University, Ambedkar University Delhi, NIMHANS (for PG)

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture / B.Tech Agricultural Engineering
degrees.exam: ICAR AIEEA-UG (via CUET-UG), State Agri CETs (MHT-CET, KCET, TS EAMCET, BCECE)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with PCB, PCM, PCMB or Agriculture stream.
degrees.desc: 4-year professional degree in agronomy, plant breeding, soil science, entomology, agricultural economics and farm technology.
degrees.path: Agriculture Field Officer (IBPS AFO in public sector banks), State Agriculture Officer, seed/fertiliser/agri-tech companies, NABARD, M.Sc/MBA Agribusiness.
degrees.pay: ₹3.5–7 LPA (IBPS AFO & NABARD/IFFCO/KRIBHCO offer strong public-sector packages).
degrees.why: A great 4-year professional degree with dedicated eligibility for banking (IBPS AFO), government agriculture posts and agri-business.
degrees.demand: Consistent public-sector recruitment (IBPS AFO, FCI, NABARD, State PSC) and private agri-tech growth.
degrees.institutes: IARI New Delhi, PAU Ludhiana, GBPUAT Pantnagar, TNAU Coimbatore, CCSHAU Hisar, UAS Bengaluru, BHU Varanasi, ANGRAU Guntur

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Horticulture / Floriculture / Landscape Gardening
degrees.exam: ICAR AIEEA-UG (via CUET-UG), State Agriculture/Forestry CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with PCB, PCM or Agriculture.
degrees.desc: Specialised 4-year degree in fruit, vegetable and flower cultivation, nursery management and post-harvest technology.
degrees.path: Horticulture Officer, plantation and orchard manager, landscaping and nursery entrepreneur, export agribusiness, M.Sc Horticulture.
degrees.why: Choose it if you love plant science, commercial floriculture or orchards and outdoor fieldwork. (Forestry has its own card.)
degrees.demand: Dedicated posts in state horticulture departments and commercial export plantations.
degrees.institutes: Dr. YSP UHF Solan, IARI Delhi, TNAU Coimbatore, KAU Thrissur, OUAT Bhubaneswar, UAS Dharwad / Bengaluru

degrees.full: B.Tech Food Technology / Dairy Technology or B.Sc Food Technology
degrees.exam: JEE Main, ICAR (CUET-UG), state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with PCM or PCB.
degrees.desc: Study food engineering, preservation, dairy processing, packaging technology, FSSAI food safety standards and quality assurance.
degrees.path: Food technologist, R&D and QA manager in FMCG (Nestlé, ITC, Britannia, Amul, PepsiCo), FSSAI Food Safety Officer, supply-chain cold-storage specialist.
degrees.why: Choose it if you enjoy applied chemistry/microbiology and want to work in India’s fast-growing packaged food and dairy industry.
degrees.demand: High demand in FMCG food processing, dairy cooperatives, export testing labs and FSSAI compliance.
degrees.institutes: NIFTEM Kundli & Thanjavur, ICT Mumbai, CFTRI Mysuru (PG), NDRI Karnal, PAU Ludhiana, Delhi University, Jadavpur University

degrees.full: Bachelor of Fisheries Science
degrees.exam: ICAR AIEEA-UG (via CUET-UG), State Fisheries/Agri CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB).
degrees.desc: 4-year professional degree in aquaculture, marine biology, fish processing technology, aquatic environment and fisheries management.
degrees.path: Fisheries Development Officer, aquaculture farm manager, seafood export quality officer (MPEDA/EIA), banking agriculture officer, M.F.Sc at CIFE.
degrees.why: A fit if you like aquatic biology, sustainable aquaculture and India’s large marine/inland seafood export economy.
degrees.demand: Strong government recruitment in coastal/inland states and commercial shrimp/aquaculture export firms.
degrees.institutes: CIFE Mumbai (ICAR PG), College of Fisheries Mangalore, KUFOS Kochi, TNFU Nagapattinam, GBPUAT Pantnagar, Junagadh Agricultural University

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Environmental Science & Climate Sustainability
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Science subjects (PCB or PCM).
degrees.desc: Study ecology, pollution control, environmental impact assessment (EIA), ESG sustainability and climate policy.
degrees.path: ESG & sustainability analyst, environmental compliance consultant, pollution control board scientist (after M.Sc/NET), GIS & conservation specialist.
degrees.why: Choose it if environmental challenges interest you and you pair the degree with GIS, carbon accounting or environmental law/engineering skills.
degrees.demand: Corporate ESG reporting mandates (BRSR) and infrastructure EIA clearances are expanding sustainability roles.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi, BHU Varanasi, Fergusson College Pune, JNU & TERI SAS New Delhi (for PG)

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Geology / Earth Sciences or B.A./B.Sc Geography & Geoinformatics
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, JEE Advanced (for 5-yr Integrated M.Tech/M.Sc at IITs), university merit
degrees.elig: 10+2 with PCM/PCB for B.Sc Geology; any stream for B.A. Geography.
degrees.desc: Explore mineralogy, petrology, hydrogeology, remote sensing & GIS, seismology and natural resource exploration.
degrees.path: Geologist (GSI Combined Geo-Scientist exam, ONGC, Coal India, Vedanta after M.Sc), GIS & remote sensing analyst, geotechnical consultant.
degrees.pay: ₹3.5–7 LPA (PSU Geologist salaries after M.Sc + GATE/UPSC Geo-Scientist are ₹10–16+ LPA).
degrees.why: A fit if you enjoy Earth science, maps, satellite remote sensing and outdoor geological fieldwork.
degrees.demand: Strong PSU and mining/groundwater career path when followed by M.Sc/M.Tech in Applied Geology or Geophysics.
degrees.institutes: IIT Roorkee, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Bombay, BHU Varanasi, Hansraj College (DU), Presidency University Kolkata, Jadavpur University

degrees.full: B.Sc / Integrated M.Sc in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science & Oceanography
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, CUSAT CAT, JEE Advanced (IITs), IIT JAM (for PG)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM; Biology also accepted for Marine Biology).
degrees.desc: Study weather forecasting, climate modelling, physical/chemical oceanography, monsoon dynamics and coastal ecosystems.
degrees.path: Meteorologist (IMD - India Meteorological Department), oceanographer (NIOT/NIO/INCOIS), climate-risk modeller in insurance/reinsurance & renewable energy.
degrees.why: Ideal if you want to apply physics, fluid dynamics and data modelling to weather, oceans and climate science.
degrees.demand: Specialised scientific demand in IMD, Ministry of Earth Sciences, offshore energy, shipping and climate-risk analytics.
degrees.institutes: CUSAT Kochi, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Delhi, IIT Madras (Ocean Engg), Andhra University Visakhapatnam, Goa University

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Biomedical Science
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB).
degrees.desc: Connect human physiology, pathology, pharmacology, molecular diagnostics and translational medical research.
degrees.path: Biomedical research scientist, clinical trial associate, molecular pathology lab specialist, patent analyst, M.Sc/PhD in Biomedical Sciences.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you love human disease biology and medical research without wanting to become a practising physician.
degrees.demand: Strong foundation for clinical research organisations (CROs), biopharma and global biomedical PhDs.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi (ACBR / Bhaskaracharya College / Shaheed Rajguru), Symbiosis, NMIMS, Sri Ramachandra Chennai

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Mathematics / Applied Mathematics
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Mathematics.
degrees.desc: Build rigorous foundations in calculus, algebra, differential equations, numerical methods and mathematical modelling.
degrees.path: Data analytics, actuarial/quantitative finance, operations research, cryptography, software, or teaching/research after M.Sc/B.Ed.
degrees.pay: ₹3–6 LPA (higher when paired with coding, statistics or actuarial exams).
degrees.why: Choose it if you enjoy mathematical reasoning and will pair it with Python/R, statistics, finance or postgraduate study.
degrees.demand: Versatile quantitative foundation across tech, finance, analytics and education.
degrees.institutes: St. Stephen’s, Hindu, Miranda House, Hansraj (DU), BHU Varanasi, Loyola College Chennai, St. Xavier’s Mumbai/Kolkata, Fergusson Pune

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Physics / Electronic Science
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics (plus Chemistry).
degrees.desc: Study mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum physics, optics, solid-state electronics and experimental physics.
degrees.path: Scientific officer (BARC/DRDO/ISRO after M.Sc + GATE/JEST), semiconductor/instrumentation specialist, data analyst, educator.
degrees.pay: ₹2.5–5 LPA at UG level; ₹7–12 LPA in national labs/industry after M.Sc/M.Tech.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you love fundamental physics, mathematical modelling and experiments, and are open to M.Sc/PhD or tech skills.
degrees.demand: Core research requires M.Sc (via IIT JAM/JEST/CUET-PG); computational physics transfers well to data science.
degrees.institutes: St. Stephen’s, Hindu, Miranda House (DU), Presidency Kolkata, St. Xavier’s Mumbai/Kolkata, BHU Varanasi, Loyola Chennai

degrees.full: B.Sc (Hons) Chemistry / Analytical or Industrial Chemistry
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics/Biology.
degrees.desc: Explore organic, inorganic, physical and analytical spectroscopy, synthesis and industrial chemical processes.
degrees.path: Quality control (QC) / analytical chemist in pharma, paints, polymers & FMCG; PSU Chemist (ONGC/IOCL/NTPC after M.Sc + GATE); research.
degrees.pay: ₹2.5–5 LPA at UG level; ₹6–12 LPA in PSUs/pharma R&D after M.Sc.
degrees.why: A fit if you enjoy wet-lab synthesis, chemical instrumentation (HPLC/GC-MS/NMR) and material analysis.
degrees.demand: Steady industrial hiring in pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals, batteries and analytical testing labs.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi, BHU Varanasi, St. Xavier’s Mumbai, Presidency Kolkata, Loyola Chennai, Panjab University Chandigarh

degrees.full: Bachelor of Commerce / B.Com (Honours)
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, state/university merit or entrance tests (NMIMS, Christ, St. Xavier’s)
degrees.elig: 10+2 (Commerce preferred; Mathematics or Accountancy required for B.Com Hons at DU).
degrees.desc: Build core expertise in financial accounting, corporate law, direct/indirect taxation (GST), auditing and corporate finance.
degrees.path: Audit & assurance associate (Big 4), tax analyst, corporate finance, banking, or alongside CA / CS / CMA / ACCA / CFA / MBA.
degrees.pay: ₹3–8 LPA (top colleges like SRCC/Hindu/LSR/St. Xavier’s reach ₹8–14+ LPA; general colleges ₹2.5–4.5 LPA).
degrees.why: Good if you like how businesses manage money, tax and compliance, and want to pair a degree with financial modelling or professional exams.
degrees.demand: Broad corporate demand in accounting, GCC finance centres, Big 4 audit and banking.
degrees.institutes: SRCC, Hindu, LSR, Hansraj, Kirori Mal (DU), St. Xavier’s Kolkata/Mumbai, Narsee Monjee (NM College) Mumbai, Loyola Chennai, Christ Bengaluru

degrees.full: B.Com / BBA in Banking & Insurance (BBI), Accounting & Finance (BAF), Financial Markets (BFM) or Taxation
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, Mumbai University merit/entrance, state & university tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in Commerce or any stream with Mathematics/Accounts.
degrees.desc: Specialised commerce programmes focused on investment banking, capital markets, treasury, risk and insurance.
degrees.path: Investment banking operations, equity research support, retail/corporate banking, insurance underwriting & claims, risk analyst.
degrees.why: Choose if you want practical coursework in securities markets, banking operations, insurance compliance and portfolio management.
degrees.demand: Strong hiring by private banks, mutual funds, NBFCs, insurance firms and global capability centres (GCCs).
degrees.institutes: HR College Mumbai, NM College Mumbai, Jai Hind College, St. Xavier’s, College of Vocational Studies (DU), Loyola Chennai

degrees.full: Chartered Accountancy (ICAI), Company Secretary (ICSI), Cost & Management Accountancy (ICMAI)
degrees.exam: CA Foundation (ICAI), CSEET (ICSI), CMA Foundation (ICMAI) — start right after Class 12
degrees.elig: 10+2 pass in any stream from a recognised board (Commerce/Maths helpful).
degrees.desc: Statutory professional qualifications regulated by Acts of Parliament (ICAI, ICSI, ICMAI); often pursued alongside B.Com.
degrees.path: Statutory Auditor, Tax & M&A Advisor, CFO track (CA); Corporate Governance, Board Compliance & Legal Officer (CS); Cost Audit & Pricing Strategist (CMA).
degrees.pay: ₹7–15+ LPA upon qualifying Final exams (articleship stipends during training are modest).
degrees.why: Pursue it if you have high discipline for rigorous multi-stage exams, articleship training and statutory financial/corporate law.
degrees.demand: High statutory and corporate demand across every listed company, bank, consulting firm and practice.
degrees.institutes: ICAI (New Delhi & regional chapters), ICSI (New Delhi & chapters), ICMAI (Kolkata/Bengaluru & chapters)

degrees.full: Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) / Certified Financial & Investment Analysis alongside UG Degree
degrees.exam: CFA Level I–III (CFA Institute) / NISM Certifications alongside B.Com/BBA/B.Tech/Economics
degrees.elig: Pursuing a bachelor’s degree (can register for CFA Level I in pre-final/final year of UG).
degrees.desc: Global professional credential in equity research, portfolio management, fixed income, derivatives and corporate finance.
degrees.path: Equity research analyst, investment banking analyst, portfolio management support, credit risk & treasury analyst.
degrees.pay: ₹5–14 LPA (varies by undergraduate college, internships and CFA levels cleared).
degrees.why: Best for students aiming for core investment management, valuation and capital-markets roles alongside a strong UG degree.
degrees.demand: Valued by asset-management firms, boutique investment banks, KPOs and Big 4 valuation teams.
degrees.institutes: CFA Institute (Global), NISM (SEBI), paired with top Commerce/Economics/Engineering colleges

degrees.full: B.Sc Actuarial Science + Institute of Actuaries of India (IAI) Fellowship
degrees.exam: ACET (Institute of Actuaries of India - IAI), CUET-UG, university entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Mathematics / Statistics and English.
degrees.desc: Apply advanced probability, stochastic modelling and financial mathematics to price insurance, pensions and financial risk.
degrees.path: Actuarial analyst in life/general/health insurance, reinsurance, pensions, risk consulting (EY, Mercer, Milliman, PwC).
degrees.pay: ₹5–12 LPA for entry analysts with 3–5 actuarial papers; Associate/Fellow Actuaries earn significantly more.
degrees.why: A fit if you love probability and calculus and are committed to clearing professional actuarial papers (Core Principles/Practices) alongside work.
degrees.demand: High specialised demand in insurance, pensions and risk modelling; progression is directly tied to actuarial exam passes.
degrees.institutes: Institute of Actuaries of India (IAI Mumbai), Bishop Heber College, Amity, NMIMS Mumbai, Madras University, IIRM Hyderabad

degrees.full: Integrated Programme in Management (5-Year Dual BBA + MBA)
degrees.exam: IPMAT (IIM Indore, IIM Rohtak), JIPMAT (IIM Jammu, IIM Bodh Gaya). Verify the current list of participating IIMs.
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (minimum 60% marks; strong Quantitative Aptitude & Verbal Ability).
degrees.desc: Direct post-12th entry into an Indian Institute of Management (IIM) combining 3 years of liberal/management foundations with 2 years of MBA.
degrees.path: Management consultant, investment banking, product management, brand manager, operations & strategy leadership.
degrees.pay: ₹12–25+ LPA at top IIMs (Indore/Rohtak) upon completing the 5-year MBA; ₹7–14 LPA at newer institutes.
degrees.why: Choose it if you are certain about a management career right after 12th and have compared the 5-year IIM fee (₹20–35 Lakh) and education loan options.
degrees.demand: Graduates sit in the same final MBA placement pool as CAT-entry PGP students at the respective IIM.
degrees.institutes: IIM Indore, IIM Rohtak, IIM Jammu, IIM Bodh Gaya

degrees.full: Bachelor of Business Administration / Management Studies / Business Studies
degrees.exam: CUET-UG (DU BMS/BBA-FIA), SET (Symbiosis), NPAT (NMIMS), Christ Entrance, IPU CET
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (Mathematics is mandatory for DU SSCBS BMS / BBA-FIA).
degrees.desc: Study corporate finance, marketing, operations, HR, business analytics and strategic management.
degrees.path: Business analyst, marketing & sales associate, financial analyst, HR generalist, operations executive, or CAT/GMAT for MBA.
degrees.pay: ₹3–7 LPA broadly; ₹8–16+ LPA at premier colleges like SSCBS (DU), NMIMS, St. Xavier’s.
degrees.why: A fit if you like business problem-solving, leadership and communication—and will actively pursue internships during college.
degrees.demand: Broad corporate entry roles; an MBA or specialised finance/analytics skillset accelerates long-term growth.
degrees.institutes: Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (SSCBS - DU), St. Xavier’s Mumbai/Kolkata, NMIMS Mumbai, Symbiosis (SCMS) Pune, Christ Bengaluru

degrees.n: BBA Logistics / Supply Chain / Aviation / HR
degrees.full: BBA in Logistics & Supply Chain, Human Resource Management, Aviation or Telecom Management
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance tests (Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya, Symbiosis, UPES)
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Apply business management to supply chains, warehousing, e-commerce logistics, HR talent management or aviation/telecom.
degrees.path: Supply chain & logistics coordinator, procurement analyst, HR & talent acquisition specialist, airport/airline operations executive.
degrees.why: Pick a specialisation backed by real industry partnerships (e.g., Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya for logistics/transport).
degrees.demand: E-commerce, quick-commerce, manufacturing supply chains and HR services hire operations graduates.
degrees.institutes: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya (GSV) Vadodara, IIMM, Symbiosis, Christ University, Loyola Chennai

degrees.full: BBA / BMS in Entrepreneurship, Digital Marketing or Event Management & PR
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Learn startup venture building, performance digital marketing, SEO/SEM, brand communication and live event management.
degrees.path: Digital marketing strategist, growth marketer, D2C brand manager, startup founder / family-business lead, event & experiential producer.
degrees.why: Great for hands-on builders who want to run campaigns, launch products or manage large-scale events and media partnerships.
degrees.demand: Every business now relies on digital customer acquisition, performance marketing and experiential brand events.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi, EDII Gandhinagar, NIEM Mumbai, Mumbai University, St. Xavier’s, NMIMS, Christ University

degrees.full: Bachelor of Tourism and Travel Management (BBA/B.A. Tourism)
degrees.exam: IITTM Admission Test / CUET-UG, university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Study destination management, airline ticketing (GDS/IATA), heritage tourism, MICE events and sustainable hospitality.
degrees.path: Tour operations manager, airline & airport customer services, MICE corporate travel planner, state tourism board coordinator.
degrees.why: A fit if you enjoy geography, cultures, foreign languages and service coordination.
degrees.demand: Domestic spiritual, heritage and leisure travel in India is at record highs; foreign-language skills boost earnings.
degrees.institutes: Indian Institute of Tourism and Travel Management (IITTM Gwalior, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Goa, Nellore), Pondicherry University, DU (CVS)

degrees.full: Bachelor of Arts (Hons): History, Political Science, Sociology, Philosophy, Public Administration
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Examine political institutions, historical processes, social structures, governance and public policy.
degrees.path: Public policy & think-tank researcher, journalism, CSR & development sector, publishing, law (3-yr LLB), UPSC Civil Services / State PSC.
degrees.why: Choose subjects you love reading and writing about, and pair your degree with internships, data/research tools or competitive exam prep.
degrees.demand: Provides critical thinking and writing foundations; outcomes depend on internships, postgraduate specialization or competitive exams.
degrees.institutes: St. Stephen’s, Hindu, Miranda House, LSR, Ramjas, Kirori Mal (DU), Presidency Kolkata, Jadavpur University, BHU, TISS, Fergusson Pune

degrees.full: Bachelor of Arts / Science (Hons) in Anthropology (Cultural, Biological & Archaeological)
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 in Science (PCB/PCM) for B.Sc Anthropology (e.g., DU Hansraj) or any stream for B.A. Anthropology.
degrees.desc: Study human biological evolution, genetics, forensic osteology, tribal cultures, ethnography and human societies.
degrees.path: Anthropological Survey of India (AnSI), UX/design ethnography researcher, public health & tribal welfare NGOs, forensic anthropology, UPSC optional.
degrees.why: Unique bridge between biological science and social culture—valuable in UX user research, public health, heritage and civil services.
degrees.demand: Niche academic and government roles (AnSI, museums) plus growing corporate demand for qualitative UX ethnographers.
degrees.institutes: Hansraj College & Miranda House (DU), BHU Varanasi, Panjab University Chandigarh, University of Allahabad, Sambalpur University

degrees.full: B.A. (Hons) Ancient Indian History, Culture & Archaeology / Museology / Heritage Conservation
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance or merit
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (History/Fine Arts/Chemistry helpful for conservation).
degrees.desc: Study excavation of ancient sites, epigraphy, numismatics, museum curation and scientific restoration of monuments and art.
degrees.path: Archaeologist (Archaeological Survey of India - ASI after PG Diploma), Museum Curator, Art Conservator (INTACH/NRLC), heritage tourism.
degrees.why: Ideal if you are passionate about ancient civilisations, heritage monuments, museums and preserving cultural artefacts.
degrees.demand: Specialised openings in ASI, National/State Museums, INTACH, private art galleries and auction houses (after M.A. Museology/Conservation).
degrees.institutes: BHU Varanasi, MSU Baroda, Deccan College Pune, University of Madras, National Museum Institute (NMI) New Delhi, Pt. Deendayal Upadhyaya Institute of Archaeology (ASI)

degrees.full: B.A. / B.Sc in Defence & Strategic Studies / Military Science & National Security
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance or merit
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Study geopolitics, national security, military history, international relations, conflict resolution and defence economics.
degrees.path: Strategic & geopolitical risk analyst, think-tanks (IDSA/ORF), defence journalism, corporate security intelligence, or CDS/AFCAT/CAPF officer exams.
degrees.pay: ₹3–6 LPA (corporate risk/think-tanks) or Armed Forces officer pay scale via CDS/AFCAT.
degrees.why: Great for students interested in international relations, national security, geopolitics and preparing for CDS/CAPF/UPSC.
degrees.demand: Growing corporate geopolitical-risk intelligence (CBSE #101) and strategic policy research.
degrees.institutes: University of Allahabad, Savitribai Phule Pune University, University of Madras, Panjab University, DDU Gorakhpur University, Central University of Gujarat

degrees.full: B.A. / B.Sc in Disaster Management, Climate Resilience & Emergency Response
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (Science/Geography helpful for GIS hazard modelling).
degrees.desc: Learn hazard mapping, disaster risk reduction (DRR), crisis response, climate adaptation and humanitarian logistics.
degrees.path: Disaster management officer (NDMA / SDMAs), GIS hazard analyst, humanitarian NGOs (Red Cross, UNDP), corporate EHS & business continuity.
degrees.why: Choose it to work on climate resilience, emergency preparedness and environmental safety policy.
degrees.demand: Expanding roles in state disaster management authorities (SDMAs), infrastructure resilience and ESG risk consulting.
degrees.institutes: TISS Mumbai (PG), JNU (PG), GGSIPU Delhi, Pondicherry University, IGNOU, Tata Institute of Social Sciences

degrees.full: Bachelor of Library and Information Science / Knowledge & Archival Management
degrees.exam: University entrance or merit (varies by university)
degrees.elig: Offered as a 1-year professional degree after a 3-year Bachelor’s degree, OR as a 3-year UG/Diploma pathway in select open/state universities.
degrees.desc: A professional degree taken after a bachelor's: manage digital repositories, academic libraries, metadata and archives.
degrees.path: Librarian in Kendriya Vidyalayas (KVS), Navodaya (NVS), universities (after M.Lib.I.Sc + UGC-NET), corporate knowledge manager, archivist.
degrees.pay: ₹3–6.5 LPA (Central school/university Librarian pay follows 7th CPC scales).
degrees.why: A stable academic and institutional career path for students who love organising knowledge, digital archives and research databases.
degrees.demand: Regular vacancies in KVS, NVS, central/state universities, law firms and research institutes.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi, BHU Varanasi, Jadavpur University, Panjab University, TISS Mumbai, IGNOU

degrees.full: B.A. (Hons) English, Hindi, Sanskrit or Foreign Languages (Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Mandarin, Arabic, Russian)
degrees.exam: CUET-UG (JNU, EFLU, DU, BHU, Jamia, Visva-Bharati)
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Master literature, linguistics, translation, simultaneous interpretation and cross-cultural communication.
degrees.path: Translator & interpreter (embassies, MNCs, IT/GCCs), localisation specialist, publishing & editorial, diplomatic support, teaching.
degrees.pay: ₹3–8 LPA (East Asian & European language specialists in MNCs/embassies often command ₹5–9+ LPA).
degrees.why: Foreign languages (especially Japanese, German, Korean, French, Mandarin) offer strong direct corporate employability right after graduation.
degrees.demand: High demand in global capability centres (GCCs), trade, localization, embassies and publishing.
degrees.institutes: JNU New Delhi, EFLU Hyderabad, University of Delhi, Jamia Millia Islamia, BHU Varanasi, Visva-Bharati Santiniketan

degrees.full: Bachelor of Liberal Arts and Interdisciplinary Studies
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, Ashoka AAT, Symbiosis SET, FLAME FEAT, Krea, PDEU tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Combine majors and minors across economics, computer science, psychology, political science, history and media.
degrees.path: Management consulting, policy research, product & UX research, communications, social sector and global master’s programmes.
degrees.pay: ₹3.5–8 LPA (varies by major combination and university).
degrees.why: Choose it if you want interdisciplinary flexibility (e.g., Economics + CS or Psychology + Media) and check scholarship availability.
degrees.demand: Strong outcomes when students pick a quantitative or applied major alongside strong internships.
degrees.institutes: Ashoka University, Symbiosis School for Liberal Arts (SSLA), FLAME Pune, Krea University, PDEU Gandhinagar, IIT Madras (HSS), DU Cluster Innovation Centre

degrees.full: Bachelor of Social Work / B.A. in Social Work & Rural Development
degrees.exam: CUET-UG (TISS, DU, Visva-Bharati), university entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Professional training in community organisation, social policy, child rights, livelihoods, CSR and welfare administration.
degrees.path: CSR executive, NGO programme coordinator, social welfare officer, healthcare/medical social worker, progression to MSW / TISS MA.
degrees.pay: ₹2.5–5 LPA (higher after MSW/MA from TISS or DSSW).
degrees.why: Pursue it if grassroots social impact, human rights and community development matter deeply to you.
degrees.demand: Corporate CSR mandates (2% statutory spend under Companies Act) and development fellowships support steady demand.
degrees.institutes: TISS (Mumbai & Tuljapur), Aditi Mahavidyalaya & Bhim Rao Ambedkar College (DU), Visva-Bharati, Loyola Chennai, Stella Maris, Jamia Millia Islamia

degrees.full: Bachelor of Physical Education & Sports (B.P.E.S / B.Sc P.E., H.E. & S.) / B.P.Ed
degrees.exam: CUET-UG (LNIPE Gwalior, IGIPESS DU, BHU) + Physical Fitness & Sports Skill Test
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream with sports participation (for 3/4-yr B.P.E.S / B.Sc P.E.); 2-yr NCTE B.P.Ed is taken after graduation.
degrees.desc: Study sports coaching, exercise physiology, kinesiology, sports management and school physical education.
degrees.path: Physical Education Teacher (KVS/NVS/schools), SAI sports coach (after NIS Diploma), fitness director, armed/police forces sports quota.
degrees.why: Good if you are an active sportsperson who wants a career in coaching, school physical education or sports administration.
degrees.demand: Steady school, university and Khelo India / Sports Authority of India (SAI) coaching opportunities.
degrees.institutes: LNIPE Gwalior & Guwahati, LNCPE Thiruvananthapuram, IGIPESS (Delhi University), NSNIS Patiala, BHU Varanasi

degrees.full: B.Sc in Sports & Exercise Science or BBA / B.A. in Sports Management
degrees.exam: National Sports University (NSU) Entrance, CUET-UG, IISM/Symbiosis entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in Science (for Sports Science/Biomechanics) or any stream (for Sports Management).
degrees.desc: Apply biomechanics, sports nutrition and exercise physiology to athlete performance, or manage sports leagues, franchises and events.
degrees.path: Sports scientist, strength & conditioning coach, sports analytics, league/franchise operations (IPL/ISL/PKL), athlete management.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you want to work on the scientific performance or commercial business side of professional sports.
degrees.demand: Growing with professional leagues, high-performance centres and grassroots sports academies.
degrees.institutes: National Sports University (NSU) Imphal, LNIPE Gwalior, Sri Ramachandra Chennai, Symbiosis (SSSS) Pune, IISM Mumbai

degrees.full: Bachelor of Performing Arts (B.P.A.) / B.A. (Hons) in Hindustani/Carnatic Music, Dance, Choreography or Theatre
degrees.exam: CUET-UG + Practical Audition / Performance Test
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream + demonstrated proficiency in vocal/instrumental music, classical/contemporary dance or drama.
degrees.desc: Rigorous conservatory and academic training in classical/contemporary music, choreography, ragas, talas and stage performance.
degrees.path: Performing artist, music composer/producer, choreographer, school/conservatory music or dance educator, arts therapist.
degrees.pay: ₹2.5–5.5 LPA (salaried teaching/media roles); performance, studio and choreography fees scale with reputation.
degrees.why: Choose it if you practise riyaz/rehearsal daily and want formal training alongside performance credentials.
degrees.demand: Schools, cultural institutions, streaming audio/film production and live events offer diverse avenues.
degrees.institutes: Faculty of Music & Fine Arts (DU), BHU Varanasi, Kalakshetra Foundation Chennai, MSU Baroda, Visva-Bharati, Natya Institute Bengaluru, NSD Delhi (PG)

degrees.full: Bachelor of Film & Television Production / B.Sc Cinema (Direction, Cinematography, Art Direction, Sound & Editing)
degrees.exam: FTII / SRFTI JET, CUET-UG, JNAFAU / St. Xavier’s / state & institute entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (Physics preferred for Sound Recording & Engineering at PG level).
degrees.desc: Hands-on training in film direction, screenplay writing, digital cinematography, production design (art direction) and editing.
degrees.path: Film/OTT director, cinematographer (DoP), art director / production designer, film editor, sound designer, ad-film producer.
degrees.pay: ₹3–7 LPA (project-based & studio production roles in Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Bengaluru, Delhi).
degrees.why: Ideal if you want to master the technical and visual craft of cinema, OTT series, documentaries and commercial production.
degrees.demand: OTT streaming platforms, regional cinema and digital ad production have expanded crew and creative roles.
degrees.institutes: FTII Pune, SRFTI Kolkata, MCRC Jamia Millia Islamia (PG), St. Xavier’s Kolkata/Mumbai, JNAFAU Hyderabad, MGR Film & TV Institute Chennai

degrees.full: B.Des / B.Sc / B.A. in Animation, Visual Effects (VFX), Game Design & Multimedia
degrees.exam: NID DAT, UCEED, CUET-UG, university portfolio & aptitude tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Create 2D/3D character animation, CGI visual effects, storyboards, motion graphics and interactive game environments.
degrees.path: 3D animator, VFX compositor/FX artist, game designer, Unreal/Unity technical artist, motion graphics designer.
degrees.why: A fit if you love visual storytelling, 3D modelling and game worlds, and will build a standout showreel.
degrees.demand: India is a major global hub for Hollywood/OTT VFX outsourcing, gaming studios and animated content.
degrees.institutes: NID Ahmedabad, IDC IIT Bombay, St. Xavier’s Kolkata, JNAFAU Hyderabad, MIT ID Pune, Srishti Manipal

degrees.full: BFA / B.A. / B.Des in Photography, Visual Communication & Graphic Design
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, NID DAT, UCEED, College of Art / Sir JJ / JNAFAU aptitude & portfolio tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Master commercial/editorial photography, typography, brand identity, publication design and visual storytelling.
degrees.path: Brand & communication designer, commercial/fashion/wildlife photographer, art director, creative agency lead, photojournalist.
degrees.why: Choose it if you have a strong eye for composition, typography, lighting and visual brand storytelling.
degrees.demand: Every consumer brand, e-commerce platform, agency and media house needs high-impact visual communication.
degrees.institutes: College of Art New Delhi, Sir J.J. Institute of Applied Art Mumbai, NID Ahmedabad, IDC IIT Bombay, JNAFAU Hyderabad, MSU Baroda

degrees.n: Integrated Law (BA / BBA / B.Com / B.Sc LLB)
degrees.full: 5-Year Integrated B.A. LL.B., BBA LL.B., B.Com LL.B. or B.Sc LL.B. (Hons)
degrees.exam: CLAT (NLUs), AILET (NLU Delhi), CUET-UG (BHU/AU/DU), MHCET Law, SLAT
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream; minimum marks as per Bar Council of India and each university or exam brochure.
degrees.desc: 5-year integrated legal education combining humanities, management, commerce or science with constitutional, corporate and criminal law.
degrees.path: Litigation advocate (after AIBE), Tier-1 corporate law firm associate, in-house legal counsel, Judicial Services (PCS-J), JAG Officer (Armed Forces), policy.
degrees.pay: ₹12–18+ LPA at top NLUs in Tier-1 corporate law firms; ₹3.5–7 LPA in mid-size firms/in-house; litigation grows with practice.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you enjoy close reading, logical argument, drafting and advocacy, and are ready for continuous reading and internships.
degrees.demand: Corporate M&A, tech/IP law, dispute resolution and judiciary offer strong long-term careers.
degrees.institutes: NLSIU Bengaluru, NALSAR Hyderabad, NLU Delhi, WBNUJS Kolkata, NLU Jodhpur, NLIU Bhopal, GNLU Gandhinagar, GLC Mumbai, ILS Pune, BHU, Faculty of Law DU

degrees.full: Bachelor of Design in Industrial, Product, Transportation, Ceramic, Toy or Footwear & Accessory Design
degrees.exam: UCEED (IITs), NID DAT (NIDs), NIFT Entrance, FDDI AIST, CUET-UG
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (some IIT B.Des programmes require PCM or specific stream criteria—check UCEED brochure).
degrees.desc: Human-centred design of physical products, consumer electronics, automobiles, furniture, footwear and lifestyle accessories.
degrees.path: Industrial designer, product designer, footwear & accessory designer, packaging & retail experience designer, design strategist.
degrees.pay: ₹4.5–12 LPA (IIT/NID B.Des placements often range from ₹8–18+ LPA).
degrees.why: Choose it if you enjoy sketching, prototyping, ergonomics, materials and solving real user problems.
degrees.demand: High demand across consumer hardware, automotive, D2C lifestyle brands and digital product companies.
degrees.institutes: IIT Bombay (IDC), IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Hyderabad, IIITDM Jabalpur, NID (Ahmedabad, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, MP, Assam), NIFT, FDDI Noida

degrees.full: Bachelor of Design in Interaction Design, UI/UX & Digital Product Design
degrees.exam: UCEED, NID DAT, MIT ID / Srishti / Symbiosis design aptitude & portfolio tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Design mobile apps, SaaS interfaces, human-computer interaction (HCI), design systems and user research workflows.
degrees.path: Product Designer (UI/UX), Interaction Designer, UX Researcher, Design Systems Engineer, AR/VR Spatial Designer.
degrees.why: A fit if you love psychology, digital interfaces, wireframing in Figma and testing prototypes with real users.
degrees.demand: Strong hiring across SaaS, fintech, e-commerce and global tech product teams; portfolio quality is decisive.
degrees.institutes: IDC IIT Bombay, IIT Guwahati, IIT Delhi, NID Ahmedabad/Bengaluru, IIITDM Jabalpur, MIT ID Pune, Srishti Manipal

degrees.full: Bachelor of Interior Design (B.I.D. / B.Des / B.Sc Interior Design & Space Planning)
degrees.exam: CEPT Entrance / UCEED / NID DAT / CUET-UG / university aptitude tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Design residential, commercial, hospitality and retail interiors including lighting, acoustics, materials, furniture and 3D visualisation.
degrees.path: Interior designer, spatial & retail experience planner, furniture designer, BIM/3D interior visualiser, independent design studio.
degrees.why: Choose it if you enjoy spatial planning, materials, lighting and turning empty shells into functional spaces.
degrees.demand: Driven by urban real estate, commercial office fit-outs, hospitality and modular home-interior platforms.
degrees.institutes: CEPT University Ahmedabad, IIITDM Jabalpur, NID Ahmedabad, SNDT Mumbai, JJ School of Art, Manipal

degrees.full: B.Des (Fashion, Textile, Knitwear, Leather, Accessory, Fashion Comm) or B.FTech (Apparel Production)
degrees.exam: NIFT Entrance Exam (GAT + CAT + Situation Test via NTA), NID DAT
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream for B.Des; 10+2 with PCM is mandatory for B.FTech (Bachelor of Fashion Technology).
degrees.desc: Create fashion collections, textile prints, luxury accessories and fashion media (B.Des) or manage garment manufacturing technology (B.FTech).
degrees.path: Fashion designer, textile designer, fashion buyer & merchandiser, apparel production technologist, fashion stylist & art director.
degrees.why: A fit if you want to combine creative aesthetics with textile science, merchandising, supply-chain deadlines and retail markets.
degrees.demand: India’s domestic fashion e-commerce, retail chains and global apparel export houses actively recruit NIFT/NID graduates.
degrees.institutes: NIFT (New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Gandhinagar & 18 campuses), NID Ahmedabad, Pearl Academy

degrees.full: B.Sc in Hospitality and Hotel Administration (NCHMCT) / Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM)
degrees.exam: NCHM JEE (conducted by NTA for IHMs), WGSHA Manipal, IIHM eCHAT, IPU CET
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream with English as a compulsory subject.
degrees.desc: Train in front office, food & beverage service, culinary production, housekeeping, hotel revenue management and luxury retail.
