degrees.path: Management Trainee in luxury hotel chains (Taj/IHCL, Oberoi, ITC, Marriott), airline cabin crew/ground ops, luxury retail, cruise lines, QSR chains.
degrees.why: Pursue it if you enjoy hospitality, people leadership and high-energy service operations.
degrees.demand: Strong placement recovery across luxury hotels, aviation hospitality, cruise lines and premium retail management.
degrees.institutes: IHM Pusa (New Delhi), IHM Mumbai, IHM Bengaluru, IHM Chennai, IHM Hyderabad, WGSHA Manipal, Oberoi STEP, Army Institute of HM

degrees.full: Bachelor of Culinary Arts & Kitchen Administration / Chef Training
degrees.exam: ICI Entrance / NCHM JEE, WGSHA Manipal, Symbiosis SET, university tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Specialised chef training in Indian and international cuisines, bakery & patisserie, food styling, menu engineering and kitchen entrepreneurship.
degrees.path: Sous Chef / Executive Chef track in 5-star hotels, pastry chef, food R&D chef, cloud kitchen / restaurant entrepreneur, cruise chef.
degrees.why: Choose it if you love cooking as a disciplined craft and can thrive in high-pressure commercial kitchens.
degrees.demand: Specialised culinary graduates are sought by luxury hotels, specialty restaurants, airlines and gourmet food brands.
degrees.institutes: Indian Culinary Institute (ICI Tirupati & Noida), WGSHA Manipal, IHM Pusa/Mumbai, Symbiosis School of Culinary Arts Pune

degrees.full: Bachelor of Journalism & Mass Communication (BJMC) / Bachelor of Mass Media (BMM)
degrees.exam: CUET-UG (DU, BHU, IPU), St. Xavier’s / Symbiosis SET / Christ entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Study print/broadcast/digital journalism, media law, documentary production, public relations, advertising and digital media.
degrees.path: Journalist, broadcast producer, PR & corporate communications specialist, advertising copywriter/strategist, podcast & digital creator.
degrees.why: A fit if you love asking questions, verifying facts, storytelling and building a published portfolio across text, audio and video.
degrees.demand: Corporate communications, PR agencies, digital media houses and advertising agencies hire skilled communicators.
degrees.institutes: LSR, Indraprastha College, Delhi School of Journalism, Kalindi, Kamala Nehru (DU), St. Xavier’s Mumbai, Symbiosis (SIMC), Christ Bengaluru, IIMC & Jamia (for PG)

degrees.full: B.A. / BBA in Advertising, Public Relations, Brand Communication & Digital Media
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, Mumbai University BAMMC, Symbiosis SET, St. Xavier’s entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: Focus specifically on brand campaigns, copywriting, media buying, crisis public relations, corporate reputation and social media strategy.
degrees.path: Advertising account planner, creative copywriter, PR consultant, brand communications manager, media planner.
degrees.why: Ideal if you are more drawn to brand strategy, creative campaigns and public relations than hard news reporting.
degrees.demand: High agency and corporate in-house demand across D2C brands, tech firms and PR consultancies.
degrees.institutes: St. Xavier’s Mumbai, Jai Hind College, HR College, DU (DCAC), Symbiosis (SCMC) Pune, MICA & IIMC (for PG)

degrees.full: Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) / Bachelor of Visual Arts (BVA): Painting, Sculpture, Applied Art, Printmaking
degrees.exam: CUET-UG + Practical Skill Test, Sir JJ / MSU Baroda / Visva-Bharati / JNAFAU entrance tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream.
degrees.desc: 4-year studio degree in painting, sculpture, applied commercial art, illustration, printmaking, ceramics and art history.
degrees.path: Visual artist, illustrator, concept artist (games/film), art director in ad agencies, gallery curator, art educator (after required quals).
degrees.pay: ₹2.8–6 LPA in commercial/applied art & digital studios; studio fine art is portfolio- and commission-driven.
degrees.why: Choose it if visual art is a daily practice and you want formal studio mentorship in fine or applied arts.
degrees.demand: Applied Art and Digital Illustration graduates have strong agency/publishing/gaming demand.
degrees.institutes: College of Art New Delhi, Faculty of Visual Arts BHU, Kala Bhavana (Visva-Bharati), Faculty of Fine Arts MSU Baroda, Sir J.J. School of Art Mumbai

degrees.full: Integrated Teacher Education Programme (4-Year Dual-Major Bachelor’s + B.Ed. under NEP 2020)
degrees.exam: NCET (National Common Entrance Test by NTA), RIE CEE
degrees.elig: 10+2 in relevant stream (Science for B.Sc.B.Ed, Humanities for B.A.B.Ed, Commerce for B.Com.B.Ed).
degrees.desc: NCTE’s flagship 4-year dual-major degree preparing teachers for Foundational, Preparatory, Middle and Secondary stages, saving 1 year over B.A.+B.Ed.
degrees.path: TGT/PGT/PRT School Teacher in KVS, NVS, State Govt & private schools (after clearing CTET/STET), curriculum designer, ed-tech specialist.
degrees.pay: ₹3.5–7.5 LPA (Central Govt KVS/NVS teachers start around ₹6–8 LPA under 7th CPC).
degrees.why: The most direct degree route after Class 12 if you want a recognised teaching qualification alongside a subject major.
degrees.demand: High demand in central/state government school recruitments and national curriculum schools.
degrees.institutes: NCERT Regional Institutes of Education (RIE Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru, Shillong), IITs/NITs/Central Universities offering ITEP, CIE DU

degrees.full: Bachelor of Elementary Education (4-Yr B.El.Ed) / Diploma in Elementary Education (2-Yr D.El.Ed) & Montessori ECCE
degrees.exam: CUET-UG (for DU 4-yr B.El.Ed), State SCERT/DIET entrance or merit (for 2-yr D.El.Ed), AMI Montessori
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (minimum 50% marks).
degrees.desc: Professional teacher training for foundational, nursery/Montessori and primary/elementary school education (Classes 1–8).
degrees.path: Primary Teacher (PRT) in KVS, MCD, state government & private schools (after CTET Paper 1), Montessori preschool educator/founder.
degrees.pay: ₹3–6.5 LPA (Government PRT salaries follow 7th CPC Level-6 pay scales).
degrees.why: Choose it if you love working with young children and building foundational literacy, numeracy and curiosity.
degrees.demand: Primary school teaching (PRT) has the largest volume of school vacancies nationwide.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi (LSR, Gargi, Miranda House, JMC, IHE), State DIETs/SCERTs, Indian Montessori Centre (AMI)

degrees.full: Diploma in Special Education (D.Ed. Spl.Ed. after 12th) / B.Ed. Special Education (Hearing, Visual, ID, Autism, LD)
degrees.exam: RCI AIOAT / National Institute & University entrance or merit
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream for 2-year RCI D.Ed. Special Education (or 4-yr Integrated B.A./B.Sc.B.Ed. Special Education); Graduation for 2-yr B.Ed. Spl.Ed.
degrees.desc: RCI-recognised training to teach and support learners with visual, hearing, intellectual, autism-spectrum or specific learning disabilities.
degrees.path: RCI-registered Special Educator in KVS, NVS, inclusive CBSE/ICSE schools (mandatory per Supreme Court/CBSE norms), rehabilitation centres, NGOs.
degrees.why: High social impact and strong employability as CBSE and courts mandate qualified RCI Special Educators in every school.
degrees.demand: Mandatory appointment of RCI-registered Special Educators across government and private schools has created strong demand.
degrees.institutes: NIEPMD Chennai, NIEPID Secunderabad, AYJNISHD Mumbai, NIVH Dehradun, PDUNIPPD Delhi, BHU, Jamia Millia Islamia, GGSIPU

degrees.full: Bachelor of Vocation (Software Dev, Healthcare, Banking, Retail, Tourism, Automobile, Food Processing)
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university merit or entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (or NSQF Level 4 certificate).
degrees.desc: UGC-recognised 3-year degree with 60% practical industry/lab training and multiple exit points (Diploma/Advanced Diploma/Degree).
degrees.path: Job-ready technical and supervisory roles in the chosen skill sector, apprenticeships, or lateral/postgraduate progression.
degrees.why: Choose a B.Voc programme only at a reputed university that has active industry apprenticeships and modern labs.
degrees.demand: Outcomes depend heavily on the specific trade (e.g., Software, Banking, Healthcare, Web Tech) and industry tie-ups.
degrees.institutes: University of Delhi (Ramanujan, Kalindi, CVS, Jesus & Mary), BHU Varanasi, TISS School of Vocational Education, Dayalbagh Educational Institute

degrees.full: National Defence Academy (B.Sc / B.Tech / B.A. from JNU + 1 Yr Service Academy Training) & 10+2 TES
degrees.exam: UPSC NDA & NA Exam (twice a year) + 5-Day SSB Interview + Medical; or Indian Army/Navy 10+2 B.Tech TES Entry (via JEE Main)
degrees.elig: Unmarried male & female candidates aged 16.5–19.5 yrs; 10+2 any stream for Army Wing; 10+2 PCM mandatory for Air Force, Navy & Naval Academy.
degrees.desc: Tri-service military academy at Khadakwasla awarding a JNU Bachelor’s degree (B.A./B.Sc/B.Tech) followed by commissioning as a Lieutenant / Flying Officer / Sub-Lieutenant.
degrees.path: Permanent Commissioned Officer in the Indian Army, Indian Navy or Indian Air Force.
degrees.pay: Commissioned officers are paid on 7th CPC Level-10 (indicatively ₹10-13+ LPA gross on commissioning); cadets receive a stipend during training.
degrees.why: Pursue it for honour, leadership, physical fitness and service to the nation. Training is fully funded by the Government of India.
degrees.demand: Highly selective (a few hundred seats per batch from lakhs of applicants); open to male and female candidates.
degrees.institutes: National Defence Academy (NDA) Khadakwasla Pune, Indian Naval Academy (INA) Ezhimala, IMA Dehradun, AFA Dundigal

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Electrical & Electronics (EEE) or Telecommunication Engineering
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, BITSAT, VITEEE, MHT-CET, KCET, WBJEE
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Design semiconductor chips (VLSI), embedded systems, 5G/6G telecom networks, radar, fiber optics and power grids.
degrees.path: VLSI design/verification engineer, embedded firmware engineer, telecom network engineer, power systems engineer, PSU officer (ISRO/BEL/BHEL/NTPC).
degrees.pay: ₹4–12 LPA (VLSI/semiconductor roles at top institutes reach ₹15–30+ LPA).
degrees.why: A top choice if you want flexibility between core hardware/semiconductor design (VLSI) and software/telecom systems.
degrees.demand: India’s Semiconductor Mission and 5G/EV electronics have created strong demand for skilled ECE/EEE engineers.
degrees.institutes: IITs, NITs, IIIT Hyderabad/Bangalore/Delhi, BITS Pilani, DTU, NSUT, Jadavpur University, RVCE Bengaluru

degrees.full: Bachelor of Technology / Engineering in Marine Engineering
degrees.exam: IMU-CET, JEE Advanced (for IITs), TMI/MANET entrance + DG Shipping Medical
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM ≥ 60%) and English (≥ 50%).
degrees.desc: Design, operate and maintain ship propulsion plants, marine boilers, turbines and auxiliary ocean machinery.
degrees.path: Marine Engine Cadet → Fourth Engineer → Chief Engineer on merchant vessels, shipyard superintendent, offshore oil & gas engineer.
degrees.pay: ₹5–14+ LPA (scales rapidly with DG Shipping Class IV/II/I competency exams and sea-time).
degrees.why: Choose it if you love heavy mechanical/thermal engineering and want an international maritime engineering career.
degrees.demand: Global merchant shipping fleets require DG Shipping certified marine engineers.
degrees.institutes: IMU Kolkata (MERI), IMU Mumbai Port, Tolani Maritime Institute Pune, MANET Pune, HIMT Chennai

degrees.full: B.Tech in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering & Shipbuilding
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, CUSAT CAT, IMU-CET
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Design ships, submarines, offshore oil rigs, autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), ports and harbour structures.
degrees.path: Naval Architect at Mazagon Dock, Cochin Shipyard, GRSE, L&T Shipbuilding, Indian Navy Directorate of Naval Design, classification societies (Lloyd’s, DNV, ABS).
degrees.why: A shore-based design and engineering career (unlike sailing Marine Engineering) focused on hydrodynamics and vessel structures.
degrees.demand: High placement ratio due to very few specialised institutes (IIT Madras, IIT Kharagpur, CUSAT, IMU Visakhapatnam) and defence shipbuilding boom.
degrees.institutes: IIT Madras, IIT Kharagpur, CUSAT Kochi, Andhra University Visakhapatnam, IMU Visakhapatnam

degrees.full: B.Tech in Ceramic Engineering & Glass/Refractory Technology
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, WBJEE
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Engineer heat-resistant aerospace tiles, fiber-optic glass, bioceramics (bone/dental implants), semiconductor substrates and refractories.
degrees.path: Materials & refractory engineer in steel/glass/cement plants (Tata Steel, Saint-Gobain, Corning, Vedanta), semiconductor & defence materials R&D.
degrees.why: A niche, high-placement engineering branch essential to aerospace heat shields, electronics, steel plants and medical implants.
degrees.demand: Strong campus placements at IIT BHU, NIT Rourkela and GCECT Kolkata due to niche industry demand.
degrees.institutes: IIT (BHU) Varanasi, NIT Rourkela, Govt College of Engineering & Ceramic Technology (GCECT) Kolkata, Anna University

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Polymer Science, Chemical & Plastics Technology
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, MHT-CET, CUSAT CAT, CIPET JEE
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Develop high-performance elastomers, biodegradable polymers, carbon-fibre composites, automotive plastics and packaging materials.
degrees.path: Polymer R&D engineer, plastics processing & mould design engineer (Reliance, IOCL, Apollo Tyres, Asian Paints, automotive OEMs).
degrees.why: Choose it to work on lightweight EV composites, sustainable packaging, tyres, coatings and petrochemical polymers.
degrees.demand: Steady recruitment by petrochemical majors, tyre companies, paint/coating manufacturers and CIPET.
degrees.institutes: ICT Mumbai, IIT Delhi, CUSAT Kochi, CIPET campuses, BIT Mesra, DTU Delhi, MIT Pune, NIT Calicut

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Mining Engineering & Mineral Processing
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, WBJEE, state CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Plan surface and underground mines, rock mechanics, drilling & blasting, mine ventilation, safety and critical-mineral extraction.
degrees.path: Mining Engineer / Management Trainee at Coal India (CIL), NMDC, Hindustan Zinc, Vedanta, Tata Steel, MOIL, DGMS Inspector of Mines.
degrees.pay: ₹5–12 LPA (Coal India / NMDC / Vedanta PSU & core packages often start at ₹10–14+ LPA).
degrees.why: One of the highest core-sector placement branches in IITs/NITs with statutory roles under the Mines Act.
degrees.demand: High demand for critical mineral extraction (lithium, copper, iron, bauxite, coal) and statutory mine managers.
degrees.institutes: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, IIT Kharagpur, IIT BHU Varanasi, NIT Rourkela, NIT Surathkal, NIT Raipur, IIEST Shibpur, Anna University

degrees.full: B.Tech / B.E. in Instrumentation and Control Engineering / Electronics & Instrumentation (EIE)
degrees.exam: JEE Main & Advanced, WBJEE, MHT-CET, KCET
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM).
degrees.desc: Design precision sensors, PLC/SCADA industrial automation, flight control instruments, biomedical sensors and process control loops.
degrees.path: Instrumentation & control engineer in refineries/power plants (ONGC, IOCL, NTPC, Honeywell, Siemens, ABB, Emerson), embedded software engineer.
degrees.why: Bridges electronics, sensors and computer control—valued by both software companies and core oil/gas/power PSUs.
degrees.demand: Strong PSU recruitment via GATE (IN paper) and industrial automation MNCs.
degrees.institutes: IIT Kharagpur, NIT Trichy, NIT Rourkela, Jadavpur University, COEP Pune, NSUT Delhi, BIT Bangalore, RVCE, BMSCE

degrees.full: Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Forestry (4-Year Professional Degree)
degrees.exam: ICAR AIEEA-UG (via CUET-UG), State Forestry/Agriculture CETs
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics (PCB or PCM).
degrees.desc: Study silviculture, forest mensuration, wildlife management, agroforestry, wood science, carbon credits and forest ecology.
degrees.path: Range Forest Officer (RFO) / Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) via State PSC (often has reserved quota for B.Sc Forestry), Indian Forest Service (IFS), paper/timber & carbon-offset firms.
degrees.why: Several states reserve a percentage of Range Forest Officer (RFO) & ACF posts specifically for 4-year B.Sc (Hons) Forestry graduates.
degrees.demand: Strong public-sector pathway in State Forest Departments, IFS, FSI and corporate carbon-credit/afforestation projects.
degrees.institutes: FRI Dehradun (PG), Dr. YSP UHF Solan, TNAU Mettupalayam, KAU Thrissur, OUAT Bhubaneswar, PAU Ludhiana, UAS Dharwad, JNKVV Jabalpur

degrees.full: Bachelor / Master of Science in Wildlife Biology & Conservation Science
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university entrance; NCBS / WII national entrance for M.Sc Wildlife
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB).
degrees.desc: Field and laboratory study of animal behaviour, population ecology, camera trapping, telemetry, habitat restoration and conservation policy.
degrees.path: Wildlife biologist, conservation scientist (WII, WWF, WCS, BNHS, Nature Conservation Foundation), forest department research, eco-tourism.
degrees.why: For students deeply committed to field ecology, endangered species conservation and scientific research in national parks/reserves.
degrees.demand: Specialised research and conservation roles; M.Sc in Wildlife Biology (NCBS/WII/AVC) is the gold standard.
degrees.institutes: Wildlife Institute of India (WII) Dehradun, NCBS Bengaluru, AVC College Mayiladuthurai, Govt Arts College Ooty, BVIEER Pune

degrees.full: Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (5.5 Yrs BNYS) / B.Sc Yoga Science (3 Yrs)
degrees.exam: NEET-UG or State AYUSH Counselling (for 5.5-yr BNYS); CUET-UG / MDNIY test (for 3-yr B.Sc Yoga)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB ≥ 50%) for BNYS; 10+2 any stream for B.Sc Yoga.
degrees.desc: Clinical training in drugless integrative therapies including hydrotherapy, clinical nutrition, acupuncture, mud therapy and therapeutic yoga.
degrees.path: Naturopathy & Yoga Physician (BNYS Class-A registered in many states), AYUSH wellness centres, integrative hospitals, luxury wellness retreats, MD Naturopathy.
degrees.why: Choose 5.5-year BNYS for a clinical doctor-level naturopathy qualification, or 3-year B.Sc Yoga for wellness & therapy instruction.
degrees.demand: Growing domestic and international demand in preventive healthcare, integrative hospital departments and wellness tourism.
degrees.institutes: Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY) New Delhi, National Institute of Naturopathy (NIN) Pune, SDM Ujire, Govt Yoga & Naturopathy Medical College Chennai, BHU

degrees.full: Bachelor of Siddha Medicine and Sciences (BSMS)
degrees.exam: NEET-UG (AACCC All-India & Tamil Nadu / Kerala State AYUSH Counselling)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) + Tamil language requirement (10th/12th or during 1st professional year).
degrees.desc: 5.5-year clinical degree (4.5 yrs + 1 yr internship) in the traditional Siddha system of medicine regulated by NCISM.
degrees.path: Siddha Medical Officer (Central/State Govt dispensaries & hospitals), National Institute of Siddha research, private practice, MD (Siddha) via AIAPGET.
degrees.pay: ₹3.5–7 LPA (Government Assistant Medical Officer Siddha pay follows state pay commissions).
degrees.why: Primary traditional medical degree in Tamil Nadu and Kerala with dedicated government medical officer cadres.
degrees.demand: Regular recruitment in Tamil Nadu/Central AYUSH dispensaries and integrative research.
degrees.institutes: National Institute of Siddha (NIS) Chennai, Govt Siddha Medical College Chennai & Palayamkottai (Tirunelveli), KUHS Thrissur, MGR Medical University

degrees.full: Bachelor of Unani Medicine and Surgery (Kamil-e-Tibb-o-Jarahat)
degrees.exam: NEET-UG (AACCC & State AYUSH Counselling)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) + Urdu/Arabic/Persian (at 10th/12th or passed during 1st prof year per NCISM).
degrees.desc: 5.5-year clinical degree (4.5 yrs + 1 yr internship) in Unani medicine and regimental therapy regulated by NCISM.
degrees.path: Unani Medical Officer (CGHS, CCRUM, State AYUSH hospitals), clinical practice, pharmacovigilance, MD/MS (Unani) via AIAPGET.
degrees.why: Offers clinical medical training at premier central universities like Jamia Hamdard, AMU Aligarh, DU (Tibbia College) and NIUM Bengaluru.
degrees.demand: Opportunities in CCRUM research centres, CGHS/State Unani dispensaries and private practice.
degrees.institutes: National Institute of Unani Medicine (NIUM) Bengaluru, Jamia Hamdard New Delhi, Ajmal Khan Tibbiya College (AMU Aligarh), A&U Tibbia College (DU), Govt Unani Medical College Hyderabad

degrees.full: Bachelor in Prosthetics & Orthotics (BPO) / B.Sc Rehabilitation Therapy (RCI)
degrees.exam: NILD / SVNIRTAR / PDUNIPPD Common Entrance Test (CET), AIIMS/ISIC entrance
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology OR Mathematics (PCB or PCM).
degrees.desc: RCI-regulated clinical degree designing artificial limbs (prostheses), braces (orthoses) and comprehensive physical/vocational rehabilitation.
degrees.path: Prosthetist & Orthotist in AIIMS/government rehab institutes, Bionics & orthopaedic device MNCs (OttoBock, Össur, Endolite), rehabilitation therapist.
degrees.why: Combines biomechanics, engineering and patient care (open to both PCB and PCM!) to restore mobility with bionic/orthotic devices.
degrees.demand: High demand in national rehabilitation institutes, corporate hospitals and global orthotic/prosthetic device companies.
degrees.institutes: PDUNIPPD New Delhi, AIIPMR Mumbai, NILD Kolkata, SVNIRTAR Cuttack, NIEPMD Chennai, ISIC New Delhi

degrees.full: B.A. / BFA in Art History, Curation, Conservation & Monument/Sculpture Restoration
degrees.exam: CUET-UG, university aptitude/portfolio tests
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream (Chemistry knowledge is helpful for scientific conservation of paintings/stone/metals).
degrees.desc: Scientific documentation, chemical cleaning, structural conservation and gallery curation of paintings, manuscripts, textiles and sculptures.
degrees.path: Art conservator (INTACH, CSMVS Mumbai, National Museum, NRLC Lucknow), gallery & biennale curator, art auction specialist (Saffronart/Christie’s/Sotheby’s).
degrees.why: A rare, fascinating career blending art history, studio craft and conservation chemistry.
degrees.demand: Growing private museums (MAP Bengaluru, NMACC Mumbai, Kiran Nadar Museum), INTACH conservation labs and heritage foundations.
degrees.institutes: National Museum Institute (NMI) New Delhi, NRLC Lucknow, Delhi Institute of Heritage Research & Management (DIHRM), MSU Baroda, Kala Bhavana Visva-Bharati, Jiwaji University

degrees.n: B.A. Child Dev & School Counselling Route
degrees.full: B.A. Psychology / Human Development + NCERT PG Diploma in Guidance & Counselling
degrees.exam: CUET-UG (for UG); NCERT / RIE & University entrance (for PG Diploma in Guidance & Counselling)
degrees.elig: 10+2 in any stream for UG; Graduation in Psychology/Social Work/Child Dev/Education for School Counsellor Diploma.
degrees.desc: Train in student mental health, career guidance, psychometric testing, crisis intervention and adolescent counselling for schools.
degrees.path: School Counsellor & Wellness Teacher in CBSE/ICSE/IB schools (mandated by CBSE affiliation bylaws), career guidance consultant, child guidance clinics.
degrees.why: CBSE mandates qualified counsellors in affiliated schools; pairing B.A./B.Sc Psychology or Human Development with NCERT’s Diploma is the official route.
degrees.demand: Steady openings across K–12 schools, ed-tech career platforms and child development centres.
degrees.institutes: NCERT New Delhi & Regional Institutes of Education (RIEs), Lady Irwin College (DU), Ambedkar University Delhi, TISS Mumbai, NIPCCD New Delhi

degrees.full: Graduate Competitive Pathway: UPSC Civil Services (IAS/IFS/IPS) & Corporate Risk / Forensic Intelligence
degrees.exam: UPSC CSE (Prelims + Mains + Interview after any Bachelor’s degree); SSC CGL / IB ACIO / State PSC
degrees.elig: Requires a recognised Bachelor’s degree in ANY stream (B.A., B.Sc, B.Com, B.Tech, MBBS, BBA, Law) + minimum age 21 years.
degrees.desc: Not a standalone post-12th degree—students complete a 3/4-year Bachelor’s degree first and appear for UPSC (about 24 All-India & Central Services) or enter corporate risk/due-diligence.
degrees.path: IAS, IFS, IPS, IRS & 20 other Group-A/B Central Services; Intelligence Bureau (IB ACIO); Corporate Forensic & Due-Diligence Analyst (Big 4 / Kroll).
degrees.pay: 7th CPC Level-10 entry for IAS/IPS/IFS/IRS; ₹4.5–10 LPA in private corporate risk, due-diligence and forensic intelligence.
degrees.why: Always choose a strong, employable undergraduate degree first as your foundation and backup while preparing for UPSC or intelligence exams.
degrees.demand: UPSC CSE has ~1,000 vacancies/year with <0.2% selection rate; corporate risk/intelligence in Big 4 & consulting is a growing private alternative.
degrees.institutes: Any UGC/AICTE recognised university for graduation; LBSNAA Mussoorie / SVPNPA Hyderabad (post-UPSC selection); NFSU (for Forensic/Corporate Intelligence)

degrees.full: B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering or B.Tech Dairy Technology
degrees.exam: JEE Main, ICAR AIEEA-UG (via CUET-UG), State CETs (MHT-CET, WBJEE, KCET)
degrees.elig: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM or PCMB).
degrees.desc: Engineer farm machinery, micro-irrigation, watershed systems, solar agri-tech and automated dairy processing plants.
degrees.path: Dairy Technologist at Amul (GCMMF), NDDB, Mother Dairy, Nestlé; Farm Machinery R&D at Mahindra, TAFE, John Deere, Escorts; NABARD/Bank Officer.
degrees.pay: ₹4–8.5 LPA (NDRI Karnal & top ICAR B.Tech Dairy/Agri Engg placements are very strong).
degrees.why: Combines core mechanical/process engineering with India’s massive dairy cooperative and farm-mechanisation industry.
degrees.demand: Strong recruitment by dairy federations (Amul/NDDB), tractor/irrigation OEMs and agri-finance institutions.
degrees.institutes: NDRI Karnal, IIT Kharagpur (Agri & Food Engg), GBPUAT Pantnagar, PAU Ludhiana, TNAU Coimbatore, IARI, Anand Agricultural University

masters.full: Master of Technology / Master of Engineering (CSE, AI, VLSI, Aerospace, Robotics, Structural, Thermal, Biotech)
masters.elig: B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc/MCA in relevant discipline.
masters.exam: GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering), institute interviews/written tests.
masters.demand: High demand in semiconductor/VLSI, AI/ML, aerospace, power systems and core R&D; GATE score is also used for PSU recruitment.
masters.salary: ₹6–18+ LPA (top IITs/IISc VLSI & CS specialisations reach ₹20–35+ LPA; AICTE/MoE GATE stipend of ₹12,400/month during study).
masters.why: Pursue it for deep technical specialisation, R&D careers or transitioning to premier IIT/IISc networks.
masters.paths: VLSI/chip architect, AI research engineer, structural/aerospace specialist, PSU executive, PhD.
masters.institutes: IISc Bengaluru, IITs, NITs, IIIT Hyderabad/Delhi/Bangalore, BITS Pilani, DTU, Jadavpur University

masters.full: Master of Computer Applications
masters.elig: BCA / B.Sc (CS/IT) or Bachelor’s degree with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduate level.
masters.exam: NIMCET (for NITs), CUET-PG (JNU, DU, BHU), MAH-MCA-CET.
masters.demand: Provides software-engineering parity with B.Tech CS for BCA/B.Sc graduates when paired with strong coding skills.
masters.why: The primary postgraduate bridge into product software development and enterprise engineering for BCA/B.Sc graduates.
masters.paths: Full-stack software engineer, backend developer, DevOps/cloud engineer, systems architect.
masters.institutes: NIT Trichy, NIT Surathkal, NIT Warangal, NIT Allahabad, JNU New Delhi, University of Delhi, Pune University

masters.full: Master of Science in Computer Science, Information Technology or Cyber Security
masters.elig: B.Sc (CS/IT/Maths/Physics) or BCA/B.Tech as per university norms.
masters.exam: CUET-PG, CMI Entrance, university selection.
masters.demand: Strong for theoretical computer science, cybersecurity, algorithms and software roles.
masters.why: Choose it if you enjoy algorithmic foundations, cryptography, systems research or academic teaching (UGC-NET).
masters.paths: Software developer, cybersecurity analyst, systems researcher, assistant professor (after NET/PhD).
masters.institutes: CMI Chennai, University of Delhi, University of Hyderabad, BHU, NFSU Gandhinagar (Cyber Security)

masters.n: M.Sc Data Science / AI / Operations Research
masters.full: Master of Science in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or Applied Operational Research
masters.elig: Bachelor’s degree with strong Mathematics, Statistics or Computer Science coursework.
masters.exam: IIT JAM, CUET-PG, ISI Admission Test (M.Tech QROR / M.Stat), CMI.
masters.demand: High demand in quantitative finance, risk modelling, machine learning and enterprise analytics.
masters.why: Ideal if you want rigorous mathematical and computational depth in machine learning and statistical decision-making.
masters.paths: Data scientist, ML engineer, quantitative risk analyst, operations research scientist.
masters.institutes: ISI Kolkata, CMI Chennai, IIT Bombay (OR), University of Delhi, Fergusson College, Loyola Chennai

masters.n: MBA / PGDM (General, Finance, Mktg, HR, Supply Chain)
masters.full: Master of Business Administration / Post Graduate Diploma in Management
masters.dur: 2 years (1 year for Executive MBA with work exp)
masters.elig: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (minimum 50% marks; 45% for reserved categories).
masters.exam: CAT, XAT, CMAT, SNAP, NMAT, GMAT, MAH-MBA-CET.
masters.demand: Flagship corporate leadership qualification across consulting, investment banking, FMCG brand management, product management, HR and supply chain.
masters.salary: ₹18–35+ LPA at top IIMs/FMS/XLRI/SPJIMR/ISB; ₹5–12 LPA at tier-2 B-schools.
masters.why: Pursue it from a reputed institute to accelerate into management, strategy, finance or product leadership.
masters.paths: Management consultant, product manager, investment banker, brand manager, HR business partner, supply chain head.
masters.institutes: IIMs (Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Calcutta, Lucknow, Kozhikode, Indore, Mumbai/NITIE), FMS Delhi, XLRI Jamshedpur, SPJIMR, IIFT, TISS (HRM), MICA

masters.full: Master of Commerce / Master of Finance & Control
masters.elig: B.Com / BBA / B.A. Economics.
masters.exam: CUET-PG, CAT (for DU DFS MBA Finance), university entrance.
masters.demand: Useful for corporate finance, taxation, banking, and mandatory for Commerce Assistant Professor roles (with UGC-NET).
masters.why: Choose it for advanced accounting/taxation expertise or academic teaching & research via UGC-NET/JRF.
masters.paths: Tax & audit specialist, financial analyst, assistant professor (after NET/PhD), banking officer.
masters.institutes: Delhi School of Economics / Dept of Commerce (DU), BHU Varanasi, St. Xavier’s Kolkata, Mumbai University

masters.full: Master of Arts / Science in Economics or Quantitative Economics
masters.elig: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with strong Mathematics and Economics preparation.
masters.exam: CUET-PG (DSE, JNU, IGIDR, Gokhale), ISI Admission Test (MSQE), IIT JAM Economics.
masters.demand: Premier analytical degree for RBI Grade B (DEPR), Indian Economic Service (IES), economic consulting, global banks and policy research.
masters.salary: ₹9–22+ LPA at top campuses (DSE, ISI MSQE, IGIDR, JNU, IITs); ₹4.5–8 LPA broadly.
masters.why: One of the highest-ROI postgraduate degrees in India if you have strong mathematical and econometric skills.
masters.paths: Economist (RBI/IES/World Bank), quantitative risk modeller, transfer pricing & economic consultant, data scientist.
masters.institutes: Delhi School of Economics (DSE), ISI Delhi/Kolkata (MSQE), JNU (CESP/CITD), IGIDR Mumbai, IIT Delhi/Roorkee/Kanpur, GIPE Pune

masters.full: Master of Science in Physics, Applied Physics or Astronomy & Astrophysics
masters.elig: B.Sc with Physics and Mathematics.
masters.exam: IIT JAM, JEST, INAT (IUCAA), CUET-PG.
masters.demand: Essential for BARC/ISRO/DRDO/DAE scientific officer posts, astrophysics observatories (IUCAA/IIA/ARIES) and PhD research.
masters.salary: ₹4–9 LPA (DAE/BARC/DRDO Scientist Grade-B starts around ₹10–12+ LPA).
masters.why: Choose it to pursue experimental/theoretical physics, quantum technologies, semiconductor physics or astrophysics.
masters.paths: Scientific Officer (BARC/ISRO/DRDO), astrophysicist (via PhD), optical/semiconductor engineer, physics faculty.
masters.institutes: IISc, IITs, TIFR Mumbai, IUCAA Pune, IIA Bengaluru, HRI Prayagraj, University of Delhi, BHU

masters.full: Master of Science in Chemistry (Organic, Inorganic, Physical, Analytical, Industrial)
masters.elig: B.Sc with Chemistry.
masters.exam: IIT JAM, CUET-PG.
masters.demand: Strong industrial hiring in pharmaceutical R&D, specialty chemicals, polymers and PSU Chemist recruitment (ONGC, IOCL, NTPC via GATE).
masters.salary: ₹4–8.5 LPA (PSU Officer via GATE Chemistry starts around ₹12–16 LPA).
masters.why: Unlocks senior R&D chemist roles in pharma/chemical industries and GATE-based PSU officer recruitment.
masters.paths: R&D medicinal/process chemist, PSU Chemist (ONGC/IOCL), analytical spectroscopist, CSIR-NET JRF/PhD.
masters.institutes: IITs, IISc, ICT Mumbai, University of Delhi, BHU Varanasi, University of Hyderabad, Jadavpur University

masters.full: Master of Science in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics or Statistics (M.Stat / M.Math)
masters.elig: B.Sc/B.A./B.Stat/B.Math with Mathematics or Statistics.
masters.exam: ISI Admission Test, IIT JAM (MA / MS), CMI, CUET-PG.
masters.demand: Top-tier demand in quantitative finance, biostatistics, Indian Statistical Service (UPSC ISS) and machine learning.
masters.salary: ₹6–18+ LPA (IIT M.Sc Statistics & ISI M.Stat have outstanding corporate placement records).
masters.why: Pursue it for quantitative mastery that opens doors to UPSC ISS, quant finance, data science and mathematics research.
masters.paths: Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Officer, biostatistician, quant analyst, data scientist, actuary.
masters.institutes: ISI Kolkata/Delhi, IIT Bombay, IIT Kanpur, CMI Chennai, TIFR, IMSc Chennai, University of Delhi, BHU

masters.full: M.Sc / M.Tech in Applied Geology, Geophysics, Earth Sciences, Meteorology or Oceanography
masters.elig: B.Sc in Geology, Physics, Maths, Chemistry or Earth/Environmental Sciences.
masters.exam: IIT JAM (Geology), GATE (GG), CUET-PG, CUSAT CAT.
masters.demand: Direct eligibility for UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Exam (GSI) and GATE recruitment in ONGC, Oil India, Coal India, MECL and IMD.
masters.salary: ₹6–16+ LPA (PSU Geologists/Geophysicists and GSI Class-I officers earn top public-sector packages).
masters.why: Essential qualification for becoming a professional Geologist, Geophysicist, Meteorologist or Oceanographer in India.
masters.paths: Geologist (GSI / ONGC / Coal India), Geophysicist, Meteorologist (IMD), Oceanographer (NIO), GIS & remote sensing lead.
masters.institutes: IIT Bombay, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Roorkee, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, BHU, CUSAT Kochi, Goa University, JNU

masters.full: M.Sc in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Genetics or Wildlife Biology
masters.elig: B.Sc in Life Sciences, Biotech, Zoology, Botany, Chemistry or allied health.
masters.exam: GAT-B (Graduate Aptitude Test - Biotechnology), IIT JAM (BT), CUET-PG, WII/NCBS Test (for Wildlife).
masters.demand: Essential for biotech R&D, biopharma, molecular diagnostics, wildlife conservation research and CSIR-NET/DBT-JRF fellowships.
masters.salary: ₹3.5–7.5 LPA (DBT-supported GAT-B programmes also provide a monthly student stipend).
masters.why: Choose DBT-supported GAT-B or IIT JAM programmes for funded laboratory research and industry placements.
masters.paths: Biotech R&D scientist, clinical research associate, wildlife ecologist, molecular biologist, PhD fellow.
masters.institutes: JNU New Delhi, IISc, IIT Bombay/Roorkee/Indore, NCBS Bengaluru, WII Dehradun, BHU, University of Hyderabad, Savitribai Phule Pune University

masters.full: Master of Science in Agriculture (Agronomy, Genetics, Pathology), Horticulture, Forestry or Fisheries (M.F.Sc)
masters.elig: 4-year B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry or B.F.Sc.
masters.exam: ICAR AIEEA-PG (All India Entrance Examination for Admission to Master Degree).
masters.demand: Required for Agricultural Research Service (ARS Scientist via ASRB NET), Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), seed R&D and senior agri-banking.
masters.why: Opens doors to ICAR Scientist positions, seed/crop-protection R&D multinationals (Bayer, Syngenta, Corteva) and state agriculture services.
masters.paths: ARS Scientist (ICAR), plant breeder, agronomist, forestry/wildlife specialist, agribusiness manager.
masters.institutes: IARI New Delhi, NDRI Karnal, CIFE Mumbai, FRI Dehradun, PAU Ludhiana, GBPUAT Pantnagar, TNAU Coimbatore

masters.n: MD / MS / DNB / MDS / AIAPGET (Clinical PG)
masters.full: Doctor of Medicine (MD), Master of Surgery (MS), DNB, Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) or MD/MS (AYUSH)
masters.elig: MBBS (for MD/MS/DNB), BDS (for MDS), or BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BSMS (for AIAPGET) with completed internship and registration.
masters.exam: NEET-PG, INI-CET (AIIMS/JIPMER/PGIMER/NIMHANS), NEET-MDS, AIAPGET (for AYUSH PG).
masters.demand: Core specialist qualification for consultant physicians, surgeons, radiologists, paediatricians, dental specialists and AYUSH specialists.
masters.salary: ₹10–24+ LPA (Senior Resident & Junior Consultant salaries; scales substantially with clinical experience).
masters.why: Essential clinical specialisation stage for doctors and dentists seeking independent specialist practice or teaching hospital faculty posts.
masters.paths: Specialist Physician/Surgeon, Radiologist, Orthodontist/Oral Surgeon, Medical College Faculty, DM/MCh Super-specialisation.
masters.institutes: AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, JIPMER Puducherry, CMC Vellore, NIMHANS Bengaluru, Tata Memorial Mumbai, MAIDS Delhi, AIIA Delhi

masters.full: Master of Pharmacy / MS (Pharm.) / Pharmaceutical Management (NIPER)
masters.elig: B.Pharm degree.
masters.exam: GPAT (Graduate Pharmacy Aptitude Test), NIPER JEE, CUET-PG.
masters.demand: High demand in drug discovery, formulation R&D, regulatory affairs (USFDA/EMA filings), pharmacovigilance and pharma product management.
masters.salary: ₹5–12 LPA (NIPER Mohali/Hyderabad placements are industry leaders in pharma R&D and management).
masters.why: Significantly upgrades career trajectory from basic B.Pharm manufacturing/sales into high-value R&D, regulatory affairs and pharma strategy.
masters.paths: Formulation scientist, regulatory affairs specialist, clinical trial manager, pharma brand manager.
masters.institutes: NIPER (Mohali, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Raebareli, Guwahati, Kolkata, Hajipur), ICT Mumbai, Jamia Hamdard, BITS Pilani, DPSRU Delhi

masters.n: MPT / MOT / MASLP / M.Sc Nutrition (Allied PG)
masters.full: Master of Physiotherapy (MPT), Occupational Therapy (MOT), Audiology & Speech (MASLP) or M.Sc Clinical Nutrition
masters.elig: Relevant clinical bachelor’s degree (BPT, BOT, BASLP or B.Sc Nutrition/Home Science).
masters.exam: AIISH Entrance, SVNIRTAR PG CET, CUET-PG, NIN Hyderabad / CFTRI entrance.
masters.demand: Specialisation in Sports/Neuro/Ortho Physiotherapy, Cochlear Implants & Speech Pathology, or Registered Dietitian (RD) clinical practice.
masters.why: Enables senior specialist roles in tertiary hospitals, pro sports teams, hearing-implant MNCs and Registered Dietitian eligibility.
masters.paths: Sports/Neuro Physiotherapist, Senior Audiologist/SLP, Registered Clinical Dietitian, Rehab Department Head.
masters.institutes: AIISH Mysuru, NIN Hyderabad, CFTRI Mysuru, PDUNIPPD Delhi, SVNIRTAR, CMC Vellore, Manipal, Lady Irwin College (DU)

masters.full: Master of Public Health (MPH) / Master of Hospital Administration (MHA)
masters.elig: MBBS/BDS/AYUSH/Nursing/Allied Health or any Bachelor’s degree (for MHA/Health Policy tracks).
masters.exam: CUET-PG (TISS Mumbai), AIIMS MHA Entrance, JIPMER/NIMHANS MPH Entrance, IIHMR.
masters.demand: Leadership roles in hospital operations, health-tech, health insurance, WHO/UNICEF/Gates Foundation and National Health Mission.
masters.salary: ₹5–12 LPA (TISS Mumbai MHA/MPH placements average ₹8–14+ LPA).
masters.why: Pursue it to lead hospital systems, healthcare consulting, epidemiology or global health programmes.
masters.paths: Hospital Administrator / COO track, Public Health Epidemiologist, Healthcare Consultant (Big 4), Health Policy Analyst.
masters.institutes: TISS Mumbai, AIIMS New Delhi, JIPMER Puducherry, NIMHANS Bengaluru, IIPH Gandhinagar/Delhi, IIHMR Jaipur, CMC Vellore

masters.full: Master of Laws (LL.M.) / 3-Year Post-Graduate LL.B. (for non-law graduates)
masters.elig: LL.B. degree for LL.M.; any Bachelor’s degree (B.A./B.Com/B.Sc/B.Tech) for 3-Year LL.B.
masters.exam: CLAT-PG, AILET-PG, CUET-PG (for DU/BHU 3-Year LL.B. & LL.M.), NLSAT (NLSIU 3-Yr LL.B.).
masters.demand: LL.M. is required for Law Faculty (with UGC-NET) and PSU Legal Officer recruitment (via CLAT-PG); 3-Year LL.B. allows any graduate to enter law.
masters.salary: ₹6–15 LPA (PSU Legal Officers via CLAT-PG start around ₹12–16 LPA).
masters.why: CLAT-PG opens direct PSU legal officer recruitment (ONGC, NTPC, PowerGrid) and academic/judicial pathways.
masters.paths: PSU Legal Officer, Corporate Counsel, Law Professor (after NET), Litigation & Judiciary, IP/Patent Attorney (especially B.Tech/M.Sc + LL.B.).
masters.institutes: NLSIU Bengaluru, NALSAR Hyderabad, NLU Delhi, Faculty of Law (University of Delhi), BHU Varanasi, GLC Mumbai, Symbiosis

masters.full: Master of Design (M.Des) / Master of Architecture (M.Arch) / Master of Planning (M.Plan)
masters.elig: 4-year Bachelor’s degree (B.Des/B.Tech/B.Arch/BFA) or 3-year degree as per institute norms.
masters.exam: CEED (Common Entrance Examination for Design - IITs/IISc), NID DAT (PG), NIFT PG, GATE (AR).
masters.demand: High demand for M.Des UX/Interaction/Industrial designers in global tech companies and M.Plan urban/transport planners in consulting.
masters.salary: ₹8–20+ LPA (IIT/IISc/NID M.Des placements are among the strongest in the design sector).
masters.why: Allows engineers, architects and arts graduates to pivot into high-paying UX, product design or urban planning roles.
masters.paths: Senior UX/Product Designer, Design Researcher, Industrial Designer, Urban/Transport Planner, Sustainable Architect.
masters.institutes: IISc Bengaluru, IDC IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Kanpur, NID Ahmedabad/Bengaluru/Gandhinagar, SPA Delhi, CEPT Ahmedabad

masters.full: Bachelor of Education (2-year, after any bachelor's) and Master of Education (M.Ed.)
masters.elig: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree (B.A./B.Sc/B.Com) for 2-yr B.Ed.; B.Ed./B.El.Ed./ITEP for M.Ed.
masters.exam: CUET-PG (CIE DU, BHU, RIE), State B.Ed. CETs (UP B.Ed JEE, MAH B.Ed CET, Bihar B.Ed).
masters.demand: 2-Year B.Ed. is the mandatory professional qualification for TGT and PGT school teachers across CBSE, ICSE and State Boards.
masters.salary: ₹3.5–8 LPA (KVS/NVS/DSSSB TGT & PGT government teachers earn ₹7–10+ LPA under 7th CPC).
masters.why: Essential if you completed a general B.A./B.Sc/B.Com and want to become a certified secondary/senior-secondary teacher or teacher educator.
masters.paths: TGT / PGT School Teacher, Principal/Academic Coordinator track, Teacher Educator (DIET/B.Ed colleges with M.Ed + NET), Curriculum Developer.
masters.institutes: Central Institute of Education (CIE - DU), NCERT RIEs, BHU Varanasi, Jamia Millia Islamia, TISS Mumbai, SNDT Mumbai

masters.n: M.A. / M.Sc Psychology & RCI Clinical/Rehab PG
masters.full: M.A. / M.Sc Applied/Counselling Psychology + RCI M.Phil / M.Psy (Clinical & Rehabilitation Psychology) or PG Dip in School Counselling
masters.dur: 2 years (+ 1–2 yrs for RCI Clinical/Rehab licence)
masters.elig: Bachelor’s degree (Psychology preferred or mandatory depending on university).
masters.exam: CUET-PG (DU, BHU, TISS), NIMHANS / CIP / IHBAS Entrance, NCERT PG Diploma in Guidance & Counselling.
masters.demand: Rising demand in hospitals, school counselling (CBSE mandate), corporate EAPs and UX research; RCI registration is mandatory for clinical diagnosis.
masters.why: Postgraduate training is mandatory to practice ethically as a school counsellor, organisational psychologist or RCI-licensed clinical psychologist.
masters.paths: RCI Clinical/Rehabilitation Psychologist, School & Career Counsellor, Organisational/HR Psychologist, UX Researcher.
masters.institutes: NIMHANS Bengaluru, CIP Ranchi, IHBAS Delhi, TISS Mumbai, University of Delhi, BHU Varanasi, NCERT New Delhi (School Counselling)

masters.n: MSW (Master of Social Work) / M.A. Disaster Mgmt
masters.full: Master of Social Work (MSW) / M.A. in Development Studies, Rural Management (IRMA) or Disaster Management
masters.elig: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
masters.exam: CUET-PG (TISS Mumbai, DSSW DU, BHU), CAT/XAT (for IRMA Anand PGDM-RM).
masters.demand: Strong recruitment by corporate CSR foundations, international development agencies (UNDP, UNICEF, Gates Foundation), microfinance and SDMAs.
masters.salary: ₹4.5–12 LPA (IRMA Anand & TISS Mumbai reach ₹10–18+ LPA).
masters.why: Transforms a humanities or science graduate into a professional development-sector, CSR or disaster-resilience manager.
masters.paths: CSR Manager, Development Consultant, Rural Marketing/Cooperative Manager, Disaster Risk Officer, Medical/Psychiatric Social Worker.
masters.institutes: TISS Mumbai, Delhi School of Social Work (DSSW - DU), IRMA Anand, XISS Ranchi, Madras School of Social Work, Jamia Millia Islamia, JNU

masters.n: M.A. Mass Comm, PR & PG Dip Cinema (IIMC / FTII)
masters.full: M.A. / PG Diploma in Journalism, Advertising & Public Relations (IIMC) or Cinema Direction / Cinematography (FTII / SRFTI)
masters.elig: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
masters.exam: CUET-PG (IIMC, MCRC Jamia, ACJ), FTII / SRFTI JET (Joint Entrance Test).
masters.demand: Premier entry route into national broadcast/digital journalism, corporate PR & advertising leadership, and mainstream/OTT filmmaking.
masters.why: Many of India’s top journalists, PR heads and filmmakers completed any UG degree first and then specialised at IIMC, MCRC Jamia, ACJ, FTII or MICA.
masters.paths: Broadcast/Print Journalist, Corporate Communications & PR Lead, Advertising Strategist, Film Director / Cinematographer / Editor.
masters.institutes: IIMC New Delhi, AJK MCRC Jamia Millia Islamia, ACJ Chennai, XIC Mumbai, FTII Pune, SRFTI Kolkata, MICA Ahmedabad

masters.full: M.A. / PG Diploma in Archaeology, Museology, Art Conservation, Heritage Management or MLISc (Library Science)
masters.elig: Bachelor’s degree in History, Archaeology, Fine Arts, Anthropology, Science (for conservation) or B.Lib.I.Sc (for MLISc).
masters.exam: CUET-PG, ASI Institute of Archaeology entrance, university tests.
masters.demand: Qualifies graduates for ASI Assistant Archaeologist, National/State Museum Curators, Art Restorers and University Librarians (with UGC-NET).
masters.why: Essential specialist qualification for curating museums, restoring heritage monuments and managing national archives/libraries.
masters.paths: Archaeologist (ASI), Museum Curator, Art Conservator, Archivist (National Archives of India), Academic Librarian.
masters.institutes: Pt. Deendayal Upadhyaya Institute of Archaeology (ASI), National Museum Institute (NMI) Delhi, National Archives of India, BHU, MSU Baroda, Deccan College Pune, DU

masters.n: M.A. Political Science / IR / Defence / Public Policy
masters.full: Master of Arts in Political Science, International Relations, Defence & Strategic Studies or Public Policy (MPP)
masters.elig: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (B.A. Pol Science / History / Public Admin preferred at select universities). General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: CUET-PG (JNU, DU, BHU, HCU), IIT Delhi/Bombay MPP entrance, TISS.
masters.demand: Think-tanks, public policy consulting, foreign-affairs risk analysis, legislative fellowships (LAMP), UPSC Civil Services and academia (UGC-NET).
masters.why: Choose it to analyse domestic governance, international diplomacy, national security and public-policy design.
masters.paths: Public policy consultant, geopolitical analyst, legislative assistant, think-tank researcher, assistant professor (after NET/PhD).
masters.institutes: JNU New Delhi (SIS/CPS), University of Delhi, University of Madras, IIT Delhi/IIT Bombay (Public Policy), TISS Mumbai, NLSIU (MPP), BHU

masters.full: Master of Science in Cyber Forensics, Information Security & Cybercrime Investigation (plus PG Diploma in Cybercrime)
masters.elig: Degree in Computer Science / BCA / IT / equivalent, OR B.Sc. in Mathematics / Physics / Statistics / Electronic Science, OR B.E. / B.Tech. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: CUET-PG, NFSU NFAT, State University PG Entrance.
masters.demand: Critical demand in CERT-In incident response, digital forensics labs, banking SOCs, Big 4 forensic technology and law-enforcement cyber cells.
masters.why: Directly bridges computer science/maths/engineering graduates into digital evidence recovery, malware analysis and information security governance.
masters.paths: Digital forensics investigator, SOC security analyst, penetration tester, cybercrime intelligence consultant, CISO track.
masters.institutes: University of Madras (Centre for Cyber Forensics & Info Security), NFSU Gandhinagar/Delhi, IIIT Allahabad, Cochin University (CUSAT)

masters.full: M.Sc. in Criminology and Criminal Justice Science (plus PG Diploma in Juvenile Justice & Juvenile Psychology)
masters.elig: Any Bachelor’s (Undergraduate) degree holder from a recognised university. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: CUET-PG (NICFS/NFSU, TISS, DU), state / central university PG entrance.
masters.demand: Growing roles in forensic & investigative agencies, corporate fraud/risk investigation, juvenile justice boards, correctional administration and victimology NGOs.
masters.why: Open to graduates from any stream who want a scientific career in crime prevention, penology, victimology, juvenile justice and corporate fraud risk.
masters.paths: Criminologist, corporate fraud & AML investigator, juvenile justice consultant, forensic social worker, police/CAPF research analyst.
masters.institutes: University of Madras (Dept of Criminology), LNJN NICFS (NFSU Delhi), TISS Mumbai, Dr. Harisingh Gour University Sagar, Madras School of Social Work

masters.full: M.Tech. in Geoinformatics / M.Sc. Applied Geography / PG Diploma in Geospatial Data Analytics
masters.dur: 2 years (1 yr for PG Dip Geospatial Analytics)
masters.elig: For M.Tech Geoinformatics: M.A./M.Sc. in Geography/Geology/Physics/Env Sci/CS/CA/IT/Agri/Remote Sensing (with +2 Maths/Stats) OR B.E. Civil Engg / IT. For M.Sc Applied Geography: B.Sc. Geology/Geography/Physics/Chemistry. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: GATE (GE - Geomatics Engineering), CUET-PG, IIRS/ISRO Entrance, state university entrance / TANCET.
masters.demand: High demand in satellite remote sensing (ISRO/NRSC), urban smart-city GIS, climate risk modelling, precision agriculture, telecom mapping and defence.
masters.why: Turns geography, geology, physics or civil/IT graduates into high-demand spatial data scientists and satellite remote-sensing engineers.
masters.paths: GIS & remote sensing engineer, geospatial data scientist, urban/climate modeller, surveying & lidar specialist, NRSC/ISRO scientist.
masters.institutes: IIRS Dehradun (ISRO), IIT Bombay, IIT Roorkee, IIT Kharagpur, University of Madras, Anna University (Institute of Remote Sensing), TERI SAS, BIT Mesra

masters.full: Master of Science in Actuarial Science & Quantitative Risk Management
masters.elig: B.Sc. (Statistics / Mathematics / Actuarial Science) OR B.Com. Actuarial Management with allied Maths & Statistics OR any degree with ≥60% marks in 10+2 Mathematics/Statistics. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: University PG Entrance, CUET-PG, IAI ACET alignment.
masters.demand: Qualifies graduates toward membership of the Institute of Actuaries of India (IAI, Mumbai) for life/health/general insurance pricing, reinsurance and pension valuation.
masters.why: Structured postgraduate route that aligns university coursework with professional actuarial papers of the Institute of Actuaries of India.
masters.paths: Actuarial analyst, life & general insurance pricing specialist, pension & employee-benefit consultant, enterprise risk modeller.
masters.institutes: University of Madras (Dept of Statistics), Bishop Heber College Trichy, Amity University, NMIMS Mumbai, Christ University, Madras Christian College

masters.full: M.Sc. in Materials Science / M.Sc. Energy and Materials Science
masters.elig: B.Sc. Physics / Applied Physics with Chemistry & Mathematics as ancillary subjects, OR B.Sc. Chemistry with Physics & Mathematics as ancillary subjects, OR B.E. Materials Science / equivalent. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: IIT JAM, CUET-PG, GATE, state / technical university PG entrance.
masters.demand: Growing rapidly with EV lithium/solid-state batteries, solar photovoltaics, green hydrogen fuel cells, semiconductor wafers and aerospace composites.
masters.why: Ideal for physics and chemistry graduates who want applied R&D careers in clean energy, battery technology and advanced functional materials.
masters.paths: Battery & energy-storage R&D scientist, solar PV & thin-film technologist, semiconductor materials engineer, CSIR/DAE doctoral fellow.
masters.institutes: University of Madras, IIT Bombay (Energy Science), IIT Kharagpur, Anna University, IISERs, NIT Trichy, JNCASR Bengaluru

masters.full: M.Sc. in Photonics and Bio-Photonics / M.Sc. Nanoscience & Nanotechnology
masters.elig: For Photonics & Bio-Photonics: B.Sc. Physics / Chemistry. For Nanoscience & Nanotechnology: Bachelor’s degree in Science in Nanoscience, Physics, Chemistry, Electronic Science, Zoology, Botany, Biotechnology, Biochemistry or Basic Medical Sciences. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: CUSAT CAT, CUET-PG, IIT JAM, university centre entrance.
masters.demand: High-tech R&D demand in laser systems, fiber-optic communications, biomedical optical imaging, nanomedicine drug delivery and semiconductor nanofabrication.
masters.why: Interdisciplinary frontier degrees open to both physical-science and life-science graduates (for Nanotechnology) with strong global PhD and deep-tech prospects.
masters.paths: Photonics & laser optical engineer, nanomedicine/biomaterials researcher, cleanroom nanofabrication specialist, optical instrumentation scientist.
masters.institutes: University of Madras (National Centre for Ultrafast Processes & National Centre for Nanoscience), CUSAT Kochi (International School of Photonics), JNCASR, IITs, Manipal

masters.full: Master of Science in Biophysics (CAS in Crystallography and Biophysics)
masters.elig: B.Sc. Physics / Chemistry, OR B.Sc. in any Life Sciences provided the candidate has studied Mathematics at the +2 (Class 12) level. Note: M.Sc. Biophysics is generally not treated as equivalent to a general M.Sc. Physics. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: CUET-PG, AIIMS M.Sc Entrance, central / state university entrance.
masters.demand: Specialised demand in X-ray crystallography, cryo-EM structural biology, computational drug design, molecular modelling and radiation biophysics.
masters.why: A bridge discipline: it applies physics, maths and computation to protein structures and drug discovery, with strong crystallography and structural-biology research traditions in India.
masters.paths: Structural biologist, computational drug-discovery scientist, cryo-EM / X-ray crystallography specialist, biophysics PhD researcher.
masters.institutes: University of Madras (CAS in Crystallography & Biophysics), AIIMS New Delhi, University of Delhi, Panjab University Chandigarh, NIMHANS Bengaluru

masters.full: Master of Science in Physics (Specialisation in Nuclear Physics or Theoretical Physics)
masters.elig: B.Sc. Physics with Mathematics as ancillary subject, OR B.Sc. Triple Major (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics), OR B.Sc. Applied Science / Applied Physics with Mathematics as ancillary. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: JEST, IIT JAM, CUET-PG, DAE/BARC OCES/DGFS, university-specific entrance.
masters.demand: Direct feeder to Department of Atomic Energy (DAE / BARC / IGCAR / VECC), TIFR, IMSc, HRI, SINP and international high-energy/nuclear physics labs.
masters.salary: ₹5–12+ LPA (DAE Scientific Officer Grade-C via BARC OCES starts at 7th CPC Level-10).
masters.why: For students who want rigorous quantum field theory, statistical mechanics, particle physics and nuclear reactor/accelerator science.
masters.paths: Nuclear Scientist (BARC / IGCAR / NPCIL), theoretical physicist, medical radiation physicist (after DipRP), quantum computing researcher.
masters.institutes: University of Madras (Depts of Nuclear Physics & Theoretical Physics), IMSc Chennai, TIFR Mumbai, SINP Kolkata, HRI Prayagraj, IITs, BHU

masters.n: M.Sc. Analytical, Organic, Inorganic, Physical & Polymer Chemistry
masters.full: M.Sc. in Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry or Polymer Chemistry (plus Cert in Analytical Instrumentation)
masters.elig: B.Sc. Chemistry with Mathematics or Physics as one of the allied/ancillary subjects. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: IIT JAM (CY), CUET-PG, GATE (CY), University PG Entrance.
masters.demand: High industrial absorption across bulk & specialty pharmaceuticals (API synthesis), analytical QC/QA (HPLC/GC-MS/NMR), paints, elastomers and petrochemicals.
masters.salary: ₹4–9 LPA (PSU Chemist via GATE reaches ₹12–16 LPA).
masters.why: Allows B.Sc. Chemistry graduates to specialise directly in the branch most demanded by pharma R&D (Organic/Analytical) or materials/plastics (Polymer/Physical).
masters.paths: Medicinal/organic synthesis chemist, analytical instrumentation specialist, polymer technologist, PSU Officer (ONGC/IOCL), CSIR-NET JRF.
masters.institutes: University of Madras (Guindy Campus Chemical Sciences Depts), ICT Mumbai, IITs, University of Delhi, BHU, University of Hyderabad, NCL Pune

masters.full: Master of Science in Geology / Master of Science in Applied Geology
masters.elig: B.Sc. Geology or B.Sc. Applied Geology obtained from a recognised university. General UGC/AICTE norm: a bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognised university, with programme-specific subject requirements. Specific university rules apply, so check the admitting university's prospectus.
masters.exam: IIT JAM (GG), CUET-PG, GATE (GG), University PG Entrance.
masters.demand: Mandatory qualification for UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Exam (Geological Survey of India) and GATE-based Geologist recruitment in ONGC, CIL, Oil India, NMDC and MECL.
masters.why: Direct gateway for B.Sc. Geology graduates into Class-I Gazette Officer posts in GSI and Maharatna oil/mining PSUs.
masters.paths: Geologist (GSI / ONGC / Coal India / Vedanta), hydrogeologist, mineral exploration specialist, geotechnical engineer.
masters.institutes: IIT Bombay, IIT Roorkee, IIT Kharagpur, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, University of Madras, BHU Varanasi, Jadavpur University, Presidency Kolkata

masters.full: M.Sc. in Medical Biochemistry / M.Sc. Medical Microbiology (3-Year Medical Faculty Track + Adv Dip Molecular Pathology)

notes.btech: Official JEE / AICTE entry is 10+2 PCM; some bridge routes exist for specific branches.
notes.barch: Only Council of Architecture registered graduates can practise as architects.
notes.mbbs: NEET-UG is the single national entrance. Check NMC rules for current eligibility.
notes.bscav: DGCA pilot licensing needs 10+2 Physics and Mathematics and a Class 1 medical; it is separate from the degree.
notes.beco: Delhi University and several top programmes require Mathematics at 10+2.
notes.bpharm: Open to PCM and PCB students; check Pharmacy Council of India approval.
notes.law: Check each exam brochure; CLAT, AILET and others have different eligibility.
notes.bsiiser: Admission channels change; confirm on the IISER, NISER and NEST sites.
notes.nda: Army wing is open to any stream; Air Force and Naval wings need PCM. Check the UPSC notice for age and medical rules.
notes.ca: Professional qualifications are regulated by ICAI, ICSI and ICMAI, not universities.
notes.bed: Check the NCTE and NTA NCET notices for the current ITEP rules.

eligNote: Master's eligibility shown here follows general UGC/AICTE national norms (a recognised bachelor's degree, usually with relevant subjects). Specific university rules, cut-offs and entrance tests apply and can differ, so confirm with the admitting university.
